jobs.description:
**Position Title:** IT/AV Project Coordinator


**Department:** IT/AV Services

**IT/AV Project Coordinator \- Job Summary**


The IT/AV Project Coordinator will act as a key liaison for coordinating and executing technology projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget. This role involves tracking orders, facilitating planning meetings, coordinating with clients, overseeing the work of internal teams and third‑party vendors, and preparing final project documentation.


Candidates must possess strong organizational, multitasking, and customer‑service skills. A strong background in IT and AV technologies is highly preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate, define, staff, and manage one or multiple IT/AV projects from start to finish.
* Serve as the primary project point of contact for management, technical teams, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Conduct site surveys and participate in project kickoff meetings.
* Develop detailed project schedules, lead project status meetings, and manage resource allocation.
* Work closely with project owners to monitor delivery performance, ensure quality standards, and manage timelines and budgets.
* Create and deliver accurate pre‑project and post‑project documentation.
* Oversee project execution, including building project plans, assigning resources, tracking progress, and ensuring timely completion.
* Collect and document business requirements and workflows from users.
* Perform quality assurance checks and prepare related documentation.
* Plan, coordinate, and deliver user training as needed.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum of five (5\) years' experience as a Project Manager, Account Manager, Project Specialist, or similar role managing enterprise‑level projects.
* PMP certification preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in client engagement.
* Previous experience working on IT and AV technical projects.
* Strong writing, documentation, and reporting abilities.
* Proven analytical and problem‑solving skills.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

**Golden Star Technology Inc. (GST)**, headquartered in Cerritos, California, has been recognized by the *Los Angeles Business Journal* as one of **LA's Best Places to Work** for six consecutive years. As a leading provider of IT and audiovisual (AV) solutions and services, GST serves small and mid\-sized businesses, enterprises, government agencies, healthcare, and educational institutions nationwide.


Since its founding in 1985, GST has built a strong reputation for innovation, reliability, and customer commitment. The company's continued growth is driven by its ability to deliver a comprehensive portfolio of industry\-leading technology solutions, customized configurations, and exceptional customer service. Through strategic partnerships with top manufacturers and visionary technology providers, GST empowers organizations to achieve their business objectives with confidence and efficiency.

**Join us and be part of a team that drives innovation and excellence in IT/AV solutions!**

**For more information, please visit www.gstinc.com**

**Position Overview**


Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented **Contracts \& Program Coordinator** to support and manage daily operations of our **NASA SEWP VI** contract vehicle.


This role is responsible for reviewing customer RFQs and bids, obtaining vendor pricing, and developing accurate quotes, proposals, and contract submissions for federal government customers.


The ideal candidate has experience in federal contracting, government procurement, proposal development, and inside or outside sales. **Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day activities supporting GST's NASA SEWP contract vehicle.
* Review customer RFQs, RFPs, and bid requests to ensure accurate, complete, and timely responses.
* Obtain and evaluate pricing, product availability, and lead times from OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.

* 3\+ years of proven inside or outside sales experience, including direct customer engagement, quote generation, proposal development, and sales cycle management.
* Experience supporting federal government contracts, procurement, or acquisition programs.

* Strong understanding of government purchasing processes and contract compliance requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.

* Excellent written, verbal, and customer service communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, procurement, contracts, finance, and vendor teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building, pricing, and submitting complex quotes and proposals for federal government customers.
* Experience supporting NASA Solutions for Enterprise\-Wide Procurement **(SEWP)**, General Services Administration **(GSA)** Schedules, Government\-Wide Acquisition Contracts **(GWACs),** Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity **(IDIQ)** contracts, or similar federal contract vehicles.
* Knowledge of the **Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)** and government procurement practices.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor pricing programs.
* Experience with **NetSuite, Salesforce,** or other **ERP, CRM, or quote management platforms**.
* Experience in the IT, technology, government contracting, or VAR industry.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation

**Job ID** 20214 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Compliance / Quality **Date posted** 09/25/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


When the work you do every single day has a crucial impact on the lives of others, every effort, every detail, and every second matters. This shared culture of passion and dedication pulses through Cedars\-Sinai, and it’s just one of the many reasons it was recognized by U.S. News \& World Report’s ‘Best Hospitals’ Honor Roll for the eleventh consecutive year and tied \#1 in California \& Los Angeles. Cedars\-Sinai continues to be acknowledged as a world leader in patient care, education, and research.


Our 915\-bed nonprofit, acute, tertiary, teaching Level I trauma center hospital is in the heart of Los Angeles. The Pharmacy Department has over 500 team members who are dedicated on providing both inpatient and outpatient pharmacy services, ensuring that patients receive high\-quality care tailored to their needs.


This is a Monday \- Friday, onsite role.


Join Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center in advancing safe, effective, and patient\-centered diabetes care across the health system. As the Diabetes Stewardship Pharmacist, you will serve as a clinical and strategic pharmacy leader in advancing a comprehensive diabetes stewardship program within the medical center. Working closely with physicians, pharmacists, nurses, diabetes educators, informatics specialists, and other members of the interdisciplinary diabetes team, you will help reduce patient harm related to insulin administration, optimize institutional glucometric outcomes, and promote evidence\-based pharmacotherapy for hospitalized patients with diabetes.


In this collaborative role, you will help design and implement a real\-time surveillance tool embedded within the electronic health record to identify patients experiencing glycemic excursions, support timely care triage, and enhance delivery of individualized pharmacotherapeutic recommendations. You will provide clinical support to frontline pharmacy colleagues through patient\-specific medication reviews, therapy optimization, and management of complex inpatient diabetes cases. You will also help coordinate medication use evaluations, quality improvement initiatives, clinical audits, and outcomes reporting designed to improve glycemic management, medication safety, and patient care. Your contributions will help establish consistent, measurable, and evidence\-based diabetes care across Cedars\-Sinai while advancing the organization’s commitment to patient safety, clinical excellence, education, and innovation.


\#LI\-RD1

=============================


* Pharm.D. degree from an accredited School of Pharmacy in the USA
* Completion of a PGY1 and/or PGY2 residency or equivalent practice experience

**License/Certification/Registration Requirements:**
====================================================


* Current pharmacist licensure in the State of California.
* BLS certification upon hire
* Board Certification in Pharmacotherapy (BCPS) or in specialty area is preferred

**What else are we looking for?**
=================================


* At least three years or equivalent experience as an inpatient pharmacist in a major medical center
* Has BC\-ADM (Board Certified \- Advanced Diabetes Management) certification, or ability to obtain within three years of hire
* Passionate about improving the safety, quality, and effectiveness of inpatient diabetes care, particularly insulin use and glycemic management
* Possesses good interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate complex clinical, pharmacotherapeutic, and operational information clearly to diverse audiences
* Demonstrates strong clinical judgment and critical\-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate glycemic data and provide individualized, evidence\-based recommendations for complex hospitalized patients
* Has an interest in using electronic health record tools, data analytics, and real\-time surveillance to identify glycemic excursions and support timely clinical intervention
* Demonstrates a commitment to quality and process improvement, outcomes measurement, and translating evidence into sustainable clinical practice
* Exhibits excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrates ability to prioritize projects to meet goals

jobs.title: School Based Mentoring Program - Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Big Brothers Big Sisters of Greater Los Angeles (BBBSLA) empowers youth by establishing enduring, professionally supported mentorship relationships for those facing adversity. We collaborate with parents/guardians and volunteers to ensure every child in our programs reaches higher aspirations, gains confidence, builds better relationships, and achieves educational success. BBBSLA's track record proves that mentoring works, transforming lives one young person at a time

**Position Overview**


Reporting to the Senior Manager of Site\-Based Programs, the Program Specialist is a dual\-function role, responsible for program facilitation and enrollment/match support across BBBSLA's school site and workplace site mentoring programs. This position facilitates engaging group mentoring sessions, coordinates on\-site program operations, and builds strong relationships with school and corporate partners. The Program Specialist also supports the full participant lifecycle for Bigs and Littles, including information sessions, recruitment, interviews, assessments, application processing, mentoring pair matching, match introductions, ongoing match support, and match closure. The successful candidate will be flexible, highly organized, culturally responsive, comfortable working with youth and corporate professionals, and committed to child safety and high\-quality mentoring experiences.


*This is a part\-time position that also requires travel for face\-to\-face meetings with corporate and school partners.*

**ESSENTIAL JOB ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The essential job activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Program Facilitation**

* Facilitate structured, engaging, and culturally responsive group mentoring sessions at assigned school and workplace sites, serving youth, volunteer mentors, and partner representatives.
* Prepare, adapt, and deliver curriculum and activities related to academic success, college and career readiness, financial literacy, health and wellness, relationship development, and social\-emotional learning.
* Serve as the on\-site program lead by coordinating schedules, attendance, room setup, materials, technology, transportation\-related communication, and other program logistics.
* Establish and maintain positive working relationships with school administrators, teachers, corporate contacts, mentors, mentees, parents/guardians, and BBBSLA staff.
* Communicate regularly with school and corporate partners regarding program progress, participation, upcoming activities, concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
* Monitor participant engagement, group dynamics, mentoring relationships, and adherence to program expectations during sessions; respond promptly to concerns and elevate issues as appropriate.
* Use effective group management, active listening, reflective questioning, and conflict\-resolution strategies to create a safe and productive learning environment.
* Support the planning and facilitation of orientations, Match Days, special events, field trips, partner meetings, and end\-of\-year activities.
* Participate in curriculum development, program planning, and continuous improvement efforts for school\-site and workplace\-site programs.

 **EnrollmentMentoring Match Support**

* Conduct enrollment processes, including interviews with guardians, youth, and volunteers, delivering youth safety education, and facilitating intake procedures.
* Review enrollment information and assessments, providing recommendations for program participation based on collected data.
* Ensure accurate record\-keeping in accordance with BBBSA guidelines, database requirements, the Service Delivery Model, and BBBSLA Program Manual.
* Evaluate the specific needs of each match participant to support a positive youth development experience for the child and a fulfilling mentoring experience for the volunteer.
* Apply expertise in child safety and risk management when working with children, youth, and families exposed to trauma, poverty, or other adverse circumstances.
* Escalate child safety concerns to the Senior Manager and report issues to the LA County Department of Children and Family Services when necessary.
* Administer the Strength of Relationship (SOR) and Youth Outcome Survey (YOS) tools to evaluate the impact of matches on youth development, track Youth Outcome Development Program (YODP) goals, and facilitate the establishment of new goals as needed.
* Document detailed written summaries of all match support interactions in real\-time using Match Force, a web\-based contact management system, to comply with national standards.
* Demonstrate a high level of proficiency in child safety and risk management, particularly in addressing the challenges faced by children exposed to trauma or living in poverty.
* Conduct exit interviews for all matches at closure, assessing the reasons for closure and re\-match potential, and record the data in MatchForce CRM system.
* Provide referrals to volunteers, youth, and parents for additional services, as needed.

Description:
**JOB TITLE**: LGBTQ\+ Program Coordinator

**REPORTS TO:** Sr. Director of Community Programs

**SCHEDULE**: Monday\-Friday 9:00am\-5:30pm

**LOCATION**: Venice, CA, Access Center, On\-site

**STATUS:** Full\-Time, 40 hrs/wk, Non\-Exempt

**ABOUT US:**


Safe Place for Youth (SPY) is the leading service provider for youth experiencing or at\-risk of homelessness in West Los Angeles. Founded in 2011, our agency offers trauma\-informed, low barrier programs that support young people in exiting the streets and achieving stability. Our robust continuum of care includes street outreach, drop\-in services, health and wellness programming, case management, education and employment services, and housing programs.


SPY is a unique social impact agency that values community collaboration, and a deep commitment to the wellbeing of youth. If you have the skills, passion, and collaborative spirit, join our growing team.

  



**ABOUT THE ROLE:**


Safe Place for Youth (SPY) is seeking a passionate LGBTQ Coordinator to lead a comprehensive LGBTQ\-affirming program that provides safe spaces, mentorship, education, and affirming resources for LGBTQ foster youth and transitional\-age youth (TAY) across Los Angeles. This role will create engaging youth programming while building the capacity of staff, foster families, and partner providers through training, allyship development, and culturally responsive support for the 1,000 youth SPY serves annually.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Facilitate weekly Queer Joy group sessions (5–15 youth per session) focusing on identity exploration, self\-care, sexual health, and navigating internalized homophobia and transphobia.
* Integrate creative, youth\-centered activities such as zine\-making, queer trivia, playlist\-building, and DIY self\-care kits.
* Create a safe, affirming environment where LGBTQ youth can build confidence, belonging, and community.
* Distribute gender\-affirming products.
* Develop and maintain LGBTQ\-specific resource lists.
* Provide individualized referrals for gender\-affirming healthcare and legal services, including name/gender marker changes.
* Support SPY staff and partners in strengthening cultural competency and trauma\-informed practices in daily interactions with LGBTQ youth.
* Partner with LA Pride, Promote, and other local organizations to host youth\-centered events and outreach opportunities.
* Collaborate with the Los Angeles LGBT Center to provide mentorship opportunities for LGBTQ youth. Co\-host workshops with AMAAD Institute on topics such as coming out, intersectionality, and identity development.
* Advocate for LGBTQ\-inclusive organizational policies and practices within SPY and across partner systems.
* Collect data and feedback from participants to inform program improvements and broader advocacy efforts.
* Collaborate with SPY’s Access Center and Clinical Teams to support day\-to\-day program operations and youth engagement, ensuring LGBTQ\+ youth are connected across all service areas.
* Implement culturally responsive outreach strategies to engage LGBTQ\+ youth and allies in SPY’s case management and wellness services.
* Plan and facilitate site\-wide community\-building events (e.g. field trips, social gatherings, creative workshops) that foster belonging among LGBTQ youth and their peers, as part of SPY’s broader commitment to inclusive, affirming programming for all.
* Support wraparound resource navigation for LGBTQ\+ youth, including warm referrals for housing, mental health, benefits, education, parenting resources, and employment.
* Contribute to multidisciplinary care coordination by participating in case conferencing and team\-based service planning.
* Provide ongoing feedback to internal teams on how to improve site\-wide LGBTQ\+ inclusion and cultural responsiveness.
* Other duties as assigned to support the mission of the organization.


Requirements:
**WHAT YOU’LL NEED:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social science or related field **preferred.**
* Related work or lived experience will be strongly considered in place of or in addition to a degree.
* 1\-2 years of experience working with LGBTQ\+ individuals in a social services, education, community based, or related setting **required.**
* Demonstrated knowledge of LGBTQ\+ affirming practices, resources, and culturally responsive approaches to supporting LGBTQ\+ youth
* 1–2 years of experience providing direct services to high\-risk transitional\-age youth **required**.
* 1–2 years of experience utilizing a trauma\-informed care model required.
* Working knowledge of child and adolescent social, emotional, and cognitive development, and trauma\-informed care service models.
* Ability to work within legal and ethical guidelines when serving LGBTQ youth.
* Flexibility in scheduling based on program needs (including evenings and weekends for events/workshops).
* Commitment and passion for the mission, vision, values, and culture of SPY.
* A self\-starter who can drive innovative, affirming programming.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* A valid California driver’s license, auto insurance, and the ability to transport youth.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Drive.
* Deep cultural humility and commitment to LGBTQ equity.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Changes in the environment, such as the office or outdoors.
* Physical effort/lifting, such as sedentary\- up to 15\-20 pounds at times.

jobs.title: Community Coordinator for Music Instrument Manufacturer
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

NUX Audio (pronounced as "New\-X") is a music\-technology brand that offers a broad range of audio and music products, including guitar and bass effects, stompboxes, multi\-effects, amplifiers, wireless systems, digital drums, digital pianos, digital wind instruments, home studio/recording gear, and accessories.

NUX sits at the intersection of **innovation, value, and usability**. NUX offers professional\-grade music and audio gear at remarkable value, designed for real\-world use across practice, performance, and recording.

**Job Overview**

As our **Community Coordinator**, you’ll help represent NUX directly within the musician community while handling key day\-to\-day digital marketing responsibilities. Reporting to the Digital Marketing Manager, this role will focus on community engagement, customer communication, email marketing, content support, and creator research.

A major part of the role is engaging with customers and musicians across social media, forums, and online communities, answering product questions, responding to customer concerns, and joining conversations about music gear in an authentic and knowledgeable way.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Answer product and gear\-related questions accurately and conversationally
* Engage with musicians in relevant forums, groups, and online communities
* Proactively identify conversations and opportunities for NUX to engage with musicians online
* Help troubleshoot basic product questions and direct more technical issues to the appropriate team
* Handle day\-to\-day email marketing, including creating, writing, scheduling, and sending newsletters, product launches, promotions, firmware announcements, and other campaigns
* Maintain the email marketing calendar and coordinate campaigns with the Digital Marketing Manager
* Help grow and maintain the NUX email subscriber list through campaigns, sign\-up opportunities, and other audience\-building initiatives
* Monitor email performance, including open rates, click\-through rates, subscriber growth, and other key metrics
* Use campaign data and audience insights to improve email content, timing, targeting, and overall performance
* Test subject lines, messaging, calls to action, and other campaign elements to identify what resonates with the audience
* Research musicians, creators, artists, and potential KOL partners for collaborations
* Assist with social content creation, including short\-form video, product demonstrations, photography, and behind\-the\-scenes content
* Assist with product and lifestyle photoshoots and video shoots
* Help maintain a consistent and knowledgeable NUX brand voice across customer and community interactions
* Stay current on music gear, industry trends, competing products, and conversations happening within the musician community

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Must actively play at least one musical instrument**
* **Strong knowledge of music gear and musician culture is required**
* Comfortable discussing music gear and technology, including pedals, amps, modelers, keyboards, MIDI, recording equipment, wireless systems, signal chains, and related products
* **Previous marketing experience is not required for the right candidate. Strong music gear knowledge, communication skills, curiosity, and a willingness to learn are more important.**
* Previous customer service or customer support experience is a plus
* Experience in music retail, live sound, recording, performing, content creation, or another music industry environment is a plus
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain gear and technical information clearly
* Comfortable communicating directly with customers and handling questions or complaints professionally
* Familiarity with social media platforms and online musician communities
* Comfortable learning email marketing tools, analytics, and performance reporting
* Able to look at campaign data and use it to make informed decisions
* Able to communicate naturally with musicians without sounding overly corporate or scripted
* Strong research skills and an ability to identify relevant creators, artists, and online communities
* Basic photo or video editing skills are a plus, but not required
* Organized, proactive, self\-motivated, and comfortable learning new tools and responsibilities
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team while also working independently

**Music gear knowledge is more important for this position than a traditional marketing background. Applicants who do not actively play a musical instrument or have a strong working knowledge of music gear and musician culture will not be considered.**

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

* Work with a globally recognized brand in music technology
* Spend your day working with music, gear, and the musician community
* Work directly with new products, artists, creators, and musicians
* Learn email marketing, community management, content creation, and creator partnerships hands\-on
* Contribute ideas to campaigns, content, and community strategy
* Opportunity to grow with the brand and take on additional responsibility over time
* Be part of a team that genuinely loves music and the gear that makes it possible
* Health Insurance, Vision Insurance, Paid Vacation, potential bonus structure for full time employees.

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: $22\.27 \- $23\.13 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

* What can you tell us about your background/interest in the music industry (what instruments you play, related projects you've been part of, etc.)?

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

PAR Apparel is seeking an organized, detail\-oriented Production Coordinator to support our apparel production team. This position plays an important role in coordinating production orders, samples, approvals, and production timelines from initial purchase order through shipment.

The ideal candidate has strong follow\-up skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced apparel environment. This role works closely with Production, Technical Design, Design, and Sales to help ensure samples and production approvals are completed accurately and on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and maintain garment purchase orders (POs).
* Coordinate Dot Com Exclusive/stock programs for company brands.
* Follow up with vendors and factories on Pre\-Production (PP) samples and approvals.
* Review PP samples for quality, color, components, labels, hangers, sizers, and other required details before submitting them to the SVP of Technical Design for review.
* Follow up on Top of Production (TOP) samples at approximately 10% of production.
* Review TOP samples for quality, color, components, labels, hangers, sizers, and other required details before submitting them to the SVP of Technical Design.
* Receive, review, and coordinate comments on production submits in partnership with Sales and/or Design.
* Prepare production submits for customers as needed and follow up on comments and approvals.
* Follow up on salesman samples, Dot Com samples, and other special\-request samples.
* Maintain accurate Time \& Action (T\&A) calendars for assigned programs, samples, and submits.
* Update and maintain Work\-in\-Progress (WIP) reports to ensure production status and approvals are current.
* Proactively identify issues or delays that may affect production timelines and escalate concerns as appropriate.
* Participate in weekly production meetings and communicate issues affecting T\&A timelines, approvals, or production.
* Recommend opportunities to improve production processes and workflow.
* Maintain organized production files and archive completed/shipped orders as needed.
* Escalate approval delays, production issues, or other concerns that may impact delivery to the SVP of Production.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to help ensure production requirements, deadlines, and customer expectations are met.
* Assist with additional projects or responsibilities based on business and department needs.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in apparel production, production coordination, product development, or a related apparel role preferred.
* Understanding of the apparel production process, including PP samples, TOP samples, production submits, and approvals.
* Experience working with garment purchase orders, T\&A calendars, and WIP reports preferred.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple styles, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Production, Technical Design, Design, Sales, vendors, and factories.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to identify and escalate potential production delays.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other standard business applications.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven apparel environment.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, dependable, and detail\-oriented. The successful candidate will be comfortable following up consistently, keeping production information current, identifying potential delays, and communicating effectively across departments to keep programs moving forward.

Please note: Depending on business needs, there may be occasions when assistance with other areas, responsibilities, or special projects is requested.

* Must have strong understanding and working knowledge of alcoholic beverage industry retail environment.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Territory Sales Account ManagerJob description:

Our company is a sanitation services company in the Western USA. We’re looking for an experienced Territory Sales Account Manager to build our large\-account presence in Orange County, California. This person will own the large General Contractor and large Event Company book in the territory — protecting and growing our existing relationships and hunting for new ones — while working closely with Operations to deliver on what we sell.

What You’ll Do

As Territory Sales Account Manager, you’ll own the top\-of\-market account development in Orange County — bringing large General Contractors and large Event Companies into the company on the strength of relationships and service, not just price. You’ll report to the Regional Director and partner day\-to\-day with the Assistant Operations Manager, Dispatcher, and CSR team to make sure what you sell is what we deliver.

You’ll be responsible for:

**1\. Bring Large\-Scale Customers to the Company:**

* Own the target list of large General Contractors and large Event Companies in the Orange County territory — Superintendents, Project Managers, Estimators, Procurement, and Event Producers
* Build multi\-touchpoint relationships that go beyond a single buyer — deep, durable relationships that don’t reset every time a project ends or a person changes seats
* Position the company on value, service reliability, luxury trailer capability, and event execution — not on price alone
* Represent the company at industry events, association meetings, and customer\-hosted events (AGC, ABC, DBIA, ISES, ILEA, IAVM, industry chapters)
* Develop and maintain account plans for each named strategic account — pipeline, project outlook, renewal calendar, expansion opportunities, and risk
* Negotiate contracts, MSAs, and pricing agreements with support from the Regional Director
* Maintain a clean, current CRM with account contacts, project pipeline, and activity notes

**2\. Create New Relationships from Scratch:**

* Hunt for new accounts through cold outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, project research, trade shows, and industry associations
* Build a personal outreach cadence — targeted calls, emails, and in\-person visits — sufficient to generate a healthy new\-business pipeline
* Convert warm leads and inbound inquiries into first orders quickly and reliably
* Establish yourself as a known name in the Orange County construction and events community over your first 6–12 months
* Approach unfamiliar customers with confidence — cold calls, walk\-ins on job sites, and introductions at events
* Move accounts from first\-order to repeat\-customer through follow\-up, problem\-solving, and personal attention
* Work with Marketing and Business Development on lead generation, digital presence, and territory awareness

**3\. Collaborate Effectively with Operations:**

* Partner day\-to\-day with the Assistant Operations Manager, Dispatcher, and CSR team on scheduling, service delivery, and customer communication
* Understand operational constraints — truck capacity, driver availability, service radius, plastics inventory, trailer availability, and lead times — before making commitments
* Never over\-promise on timing or scope; when a request is tight, work the tradeoff with Ops before committing to the customer
* Understand the pricing floor and margin expectations by service type; escalate below\-floor pricing rather than absorbing it
* Provide Ops with accurate order details — site access, hazards, timing, delivery windows, event schedules, permit needs
* Escalate scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or service risks to Ops and the customer before they become problems
* Communicate service issues back to customers proactively — own the customer relationship through the miss, not around it
* Debrief with Ops after service complaints or misses; close the loop and prevent repeat issues

Key Performance Indicators

* New named accounts won per quarter (large GC, large Event)
* Territory revenue growth vs. plan
* Gross margin on managed accounts (avoid winning on price alone)
* Pipeline coverage — active opportunities relative to quota
* Customer retention and expansion — dollars per account year over year
* Response time on customer inquiries and quotes
* CRM hygiene — accounts, contacts, activities, and forecast current
* Named\-account penetration — number of buying contacts per top account

Expectations

* Field\-forward posture — on job sites, at customer offices, at industry events, walking event venues
* Weekly pipeline review with the Regional Director; disciplined forecasting
* Direct, honest communication with both customers and internal partners
* Comfort with rejection and tenacity through long sales cycles typical of large GC accounts
* Ownership of customer outcomes — from first quote through renewal
* Alignment with and reinforcement of company Mission, Vision, and Values

Requirements

* 5\+ years of business\-to\-business sales experience with a proven record of hitting new\-business quotas
* **Must have:** experience selling portable toilets and portable sanitation services into the Construction industry, Event industry, or both
* Established network of relationships with Orange County General Contractors, Event Producers, or both
* Bathroom trailer / luxury restroom trailer sales experience preferred
* Strong hunting skills — cold outreach, prospecting, and comfort approaching new customers
* Ability to sell on value, service, and relationship rather than lowest price
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Proficiency in CRM tools; disciplined about pipeline and activity tracking
* Willingness to travel throughout the Orange County territory and adjacent markets as needed
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
* Commitment to safety, quality, and customer service

Compensation:

* Competitive base salary plus commission tied to new\-business acquisition, revenue growth

As AI workloads drive data volumes to grow at an unprecedented pace, demand for Fujifilm’s magnetic tape is expanding rapidly. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative**

**Unite Health Share Ministries (UHSM)** is a nonprofit, faith\-based health sharing ministry that facilitates member\-to\-member health sharing among fellow Christians, serving as a connector to administer medical cost sharing. The UHSM mission is to help Christian families fulfill their God\-given purpose to care for one another and to positively impact our communities. Headquartered in Norfolk, VA, UHSM takes a modern approach to health sharing that prioritizes holistic health and wellbeing. UHSM offers simple, fair, and friendly health share programs to its members.

**About this role**


Are you a dynamic and ambitious **Sales Development Representative** with a passion for expanding customer bases and generating qualified sales opportunities? If so, we want you on board to help UHSM revolutionize the healthcare industry! As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our Team Development Leader and take ownership of engaging prospective individuals and families, paving the way for our Account Executive team to close deals. Join us in our mission to provide customizable healthcare solutions that help individuals and businesses reduce costs, protect their assets, manage risks, and achieve financial success.

**On\-site**: This is a full\-time, in\-office position at our Santa Ana, CA location.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Learn \& become an expert on UHSM’s product offerings.
* Leverage opportunities to learn the market and business.
* Contact leads via phone, auto\-dialer, email, and/or web chat to qualify prospects and promote UHSM product offerings and services.
* Answer inbound direct calls from prospective new members to pre\-qualify and provide opportunities for the Account Executive team.
* Work with team members to meet conversion, acquisition, and revenue goals.
* Maintain detailed records of outgoing and ingoing calls as well as follow\-up information and outcomes.
* Meet or exceed projected weekly and monthly performance targets.
* Intercept and respond to customer complaints or concerns with products and seek to resolve the problem while adhering to company policy.
* Accurately document the customer's personal information including phone number, address, and other order information.
* Persuasively engage the customer in conversation to explain how UHSM products and/or services will add value to their lives and meet their needs.
* Ask relevant leading questions to understand the customer's needs.
* Follow prepared scripts to provide accurate and compliant information.
* Contribute to overall team success \- relay any information that may be of value to the team such as best practices, market sentiment, competitive pressures, etc.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 1\+ years of customer service, sales, or sales development experience.
* 1\+ years of experience with CRM or sales enablement software.
* Able to work in our Santa Ana, CA office location.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Healthcare sales experience.
* Strong technical aptitude.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving ability.
* Creativity, curiosity, and desire to find “the third alternative” when faced with a challenge.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Desire to make an impact at a disruptive technology company.
* Excellent interpersonal oral and written communication skills.
* Avid learner – our company is always evolving, and your knowledge must evolve too!
* Able to accept constructive criticism and continually improve sales techniques.
* Experience in a position where meeting sales goals was an important indication of performance.
* Eagerness to grow.

 **What we offer**

* Competitive Hourly \+ Bonus
* Health, Dental, Vision, and 403(b) with company match.
* Ability to make important enhancements to the Healthcare industry.
* Great culture where you work with the founders and key stakeholders in a relaxed, but innovative atmosphere.

  

UHSM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our business is fast\-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business needs. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Client Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

  

The Client Relationship Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day service and management of a book of employer\-sponsored retirement plans, including 401(k) and 403(b) plans. The position serves as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors and coordinates all work involving the recordkeeper, third\-party administrator, plan auditor, payroll provider, and HUB's internal investment and financial planning teams.

  

The Client Relationship Manager interacts regularly with CFOs, HR Directors, controllers, business owners, and retirement plan committees, and also serves as a resource to plan participants. The position is service\- and retention\-focused rather than production\-focused, though the Client Relationship Manager is expected to identify plan design, compliance, and financial wellness opportunities within the assigned book and bring them to the client for consideration.

  

This is a hands\-on role on a small team, and the Client Relationship Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and ownership as part of a collaborative practice. This includes managing their own calendar, scheduling client and vendor meetings, answering and returning calls, submitting expense reports, and coordinating client gifting within firm guidelines. The position does not assume dedicated administrative or support staff. The expectation is that this person identifies what needs to be done and acts on it, and brings a recommended course of action rather than only flagging the problem. Beyond the assigned book, the Client Relationship Manager is expected to contribute to the strength and efficiency of the overall practice.

**Primary Responsibilities**
============================

**New Client Onboarding and Implementation**
--------------------------------------------

* Manage the onboarding process for new advisory clients, including Broker of Record (BOR) paperwork, advisory and consulting agreements, 408(b)(2\) disclosures, vendor authorization and system access forms, and adoption of the Investment Policy Statement.
* Develop and manage the onboarding project plan, coordinate vendor deliverables and deadlines, and provide status updates to the client.
* Establish the ongoing service calendar for each relationship, including committee meeting cadence, compliance milestones, and the participant education schedule.
* Coordinate the rollout of HUB's financial wellness and financial coaching program (FinPath by HUB), including implementation planning, sponsor and employee communications, ongoing promotion, and engagement reporting.
* Support new business proposals and RFP responses for prospective retirement plan clients, including plan data compilation, vendor comparison, and preparation of client\-facing materials, as directed.

**Ongoing Client Service and Relationship Management**
------------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the plan sponsor on all matters relating to the retirement plan.
* Review inbound correspondence from recordkeepers, TPAs, auditors, and other plan vendors; determine required action; resolve items directly with the vendor; and involve the client only where a sponsor decision or signature is required.
* Escalate and track unresolved service issues with recordkeeper and TPA service teams through resolution.
* Coordinate quarterly and annual investment review and plan committee meetings with HUB's investment team, including scheduling, agenda preparation, materials, logistics, meeting minutes, and follow\-up item tracking.
* Maintain the client fiduciary file, including meeting minutes, Investment Policy Statement, fee benchmarking documentation, plan documents, participant notices, and vendor disclosures.
* Own the integrity of all client and plan records in Microsoft Dynamics 365 for the assigned book, including contact information, fee schedules, service agreement terms, compliance deadlines, and activity history. Records should be current, complete, and usable by any team member at any time.

**Vendor Relationships**
------------------------

* Serve as the team's primary relationship contact for assigned recordkeepers and TPAs, independent of any specific client event or service issue.
* Attend and represent the team in recordkeeper and TPA relationship meetings, quarterly business reviews, and platform update briefings.
* Maintain a current directory of vendor contacts across service, relationship management, and escalation, and keep team\-level platform access and credentialing current.

**Plan Design and Plan Document Maintenance**
---------------------------------------------

* Maintain a working knowledge of qualified plan design sufficient to discuss design alternatives with clients and to identify circumstances in which a design change should be considered — for example, a plan consistently failing or narrowly passing nondiscrimination testing, resulting in corrective refunds to highly compensated employees.
* Work with the plan's TPA to obtain census\-based cost projections for proposed design changes, such as a safe harbor match, an increase or restructuring of the employer match, or the addition of a profit sharing or new comparability allocation, and present the results to the client.
* Manage the plan amendment process from identification through implementation: coordinate drafting with the recordkeeper or TPA, review amendment language against the client's stated intent, obtain client execution, and confirm that the recordkeeper and TPA have implemented the change in the plan document and in their administrative systems.
* Manage required restatements and amendments, including the SECURE 2\.0 restatement cycle, through client review, sign\-off, and execution.
* Prepare and coordinate distribution of related participant notices, including safe harbor, QDIA, automatic enrollment and escalation, blackout, summary of material modifications, and annual fe

Our mission is to build the next\-gen CRM. As a BDR your main objective is to be the first spark for our future customers, turning cold curiosity into momentum from first hello to discovery call.


**Competencies**
----------------


This is not about ticking boxes or tallying years of experience. It is something deeper. The people who thrive here share a few things:


* **Curiosity**: Always learning, and learning quickly, whether it's about new prospects, our product, technology, client success, or the sales process. Open to feedback and thriving on it.
* **Perceptive and focused:** Alert to what people say, with a knack for asking the right questions and listening intently. Extraordinary communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* **Results driven:** Setting clear goals and achieving them. Self\-motivated to succeed, and to succeed in the right way. Creating relationships and deals that last.

Our existing team come from diverse backgrounds, but a few things tie us together:


* A proven track record of at least 12 months in B2B sales, SDR, BDR, or talent acquisition
* A strong academic background, usually with standout extracurricular achievements
* A desire to take on a bigger challenge and a no excuses mindset

**Trajectory**
--------------


You will have responsibility from the get\-go, and an accelerated career path awaits. Within Planhat, we're the engine room that drives growth. For our prospective customers, we're the front\-of\-house and the all important first introduction to the company. The BDR team are comfortable blending long\-term thinking and short\-term pragmatism, whether:


* Identifying prospects and conducting outreach through calls, emails, and LinkedIn
* Building strong relationships with post\-sales leaders across our key markets
* Qualifying, then prioritizing the needs and aspirations of executives across different industries, seniority levels, and company sizes
* Laying the groundwork for customer discovery calls for Account Executives with prospects across SMB, Mid\-market, and Enterprise

From there the path accelerates. You progress toward more senior roles and greater responsibility, with a clear route toward becoming an Account Executive. You build entrepreneurial skills at the forefront of a growing business rather than reading about it, take on leadership opportunities as the team scales, and gain exposure across markets and potentially across our offices in the USA and EMEA.  

  

  



**Definition of Success**
-------------------------


* You have taken on real responsibility from day one and earned the trust of the team around you
* You are consistently hitting and exceeding your meeting and pipeline targets
* You are generating high quality qualified pipeline that converts into discovery calls and revenue for Account Executives
* You are seen as a trusted partner by the AE team and by Customer Success leaders across your markets
* You are turning outreach into relationships and deals that last

----------------


The OTE (base \+ variable) salary range for this position is $75,000 \- $95,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Head Coach & Community Manager - Woodland Hills, CA
jobs.description:
\[solidcore] is looking for a Head Coach who is passionate about sharing the \[solidcore] brand and workout. Reporting to the Area Manager, the Head Coach is responsible for various tasks that will not only support the Studio and its success, but also support \[solidcore] as a company in our mission to be the fastest growing and most successful boutique fitness studio. The Head Coach is expected to role model all of the qualities and attributes of an exceptional coach – the Head Coach is expected to coach an average of eleven (11\) classes per week. Responsible for delivering a best in class experience, setting the standards for other coaches to aspire to. The Head Coach provides a high level of coach development, giving consistent feedback to their team with the ability to provide support in\-studio throughout new coach trainings.
### **You will be responsible for:**

* Serving as the \[solidcore] studio’s lead coach, maintaining a full schedule of 11 classes per week.
* Serving as an example and setting the expectations for new and existing coaches.
* Delivering a best\-in\-class fitness and customer service experience consistent with \[solidcore] standards.
* Meeting company utilization \& retention expectations on both an individual level and for the studio as a whole.
* Taking direction from the Area Manager to assist with day\-to\-day operations of the studio.
* Lead outreach and marketing efforts as necessary to scout new clients and create long\-term partnerships in the community.
* Providing coach development to a team of coaches, delivering informal/formal feedback \& assisting new coach trainings with in\-person support.
* Assisting as needed with responses to client requests and resolving concerns promptly and effectively.
* Maintaining product knowledge for all studio retail operations, including class packages, current promotions, and apparel.
* Executing routine operational tasks including, but not limited to ordering supplies, conducting inventory, and maintaining sales logs.
* Ensuring the studio and equipment remain impeccable and fully\-functioning at all times.
* Other duties and projects as assigned and as needed.

### **What we need from you:**

* This is a permanent, exempt, full\-time position with an expected 40 hours per week (including classes coached).
* Flexible and variable availability including weekends \& holidays with ability to accommodate coach training schedules \& the fluctuating needs of the business.
* Ability to lift / carry a minimum of 30 pounds.
* Proficiency in g\-Suite and MS office, specifically excel and google sheets.

### **What skills and experience you will bring to us:**

* Optimism and hard work with a love for health, fitness, and the \[solidcore] workout.
* Passionate about helping others become the strongest version of themselves and achieve their goals.
* Passionate about building relationships and developing teams, creating an environment that fosters growth.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, people\-focused, entrepreneurial environment.
* 1\-2 years prior group fitness experience.
* Outgoing and personable with a desire to build relationships within and outside the \[solidcore] community.
* Team player with a positive attitude.
* Genuine desire to inspire and motivate others.
* Reliable and professional.
* Comfortable on a mic leading a fast\-paced class with loud music and lots of energy in the room.
* Ability to model the \[solidcore] brand and culture and serve as a lead representative of the \[solidcore] community.
* Superior client relations and communication skills.

### **Compensation \& Benefits**

* Compensation Range: $68,004\-$75,654 per year
* Flexible PTO
* Full coverage health, dental, \& vision insurance
* 401k with employer match
* Cellphone stipend
* And MORE!

\[solidcore] is a national boutique fitness company with 100\+ studios across the country. Our signature workout is 50 minutes of low\-impact, high\-intensity strength training: the lights are low and the music is loud. The coach guides the class through a series of slow \& controlled movements that are sequenced to work muscles to failure. This class is accessible for all fitness levels and can be amplified or modified to accommodate individual goals. Class is as intense as our reviews suggest, but our instructors go above and beyond to provide a welcoming, supportive, empowering, and challenging experience for all. Please visit our website here to read more about our mission.  

\[solidcore] is firmly committed to social justice and promoting a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. You can click here to find out more about the actions we are taking to promote a more diverse and inclusive space for both our clients and our internal team.  

\[solidcore] is an equal\-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. \[solidcore] makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**CarsDirect and Auto Credit Express**, both part of the Internet Brands automotive family, are trusted leaders in the car\-buying and financing space, serving millions of customers nationwide.

**CarsDirect** simplifies the car shopping experience by helping consumers research vehicles, compare prices, and connect directly with local dealerships to buy or lease new and used cars. We make it easy for anyone \- regardless of credit history \- to find the right car at the right price.

**Auto Credit Express** focuses on empowering customers with challenged or limited credit. Our large network of dealership partners helps these customers get approved for auto loans and back on the road, while rebuilding their financial confidence.


Together, these brands empower car buyers by providing tools, resources, and connections to make confident, informed decisions.


CarsDirect/AutoCreditExpress is in search of an Inside Sales Representative to join our team in El Segundo, CA.


Our ideal candidate is energetic, resourceful, and a take\-charge individual who can take prospects through the full sales cycle from **prospecting to close.****Key Skills and Experience:*** B2B sales experience preferred (at least 6 months of experience)
* Automotive and social media experience (plus)
* Excellent phone skills (50\-60 cold calls per day) and written communication.
* Outstanding time management and ability to multitask.
* Strong sales results paired with a high degree of initiative, follow\-up, and product retention.
* Proficiency in workplace applications such as Word, Excel, and Google Suite.

**Why you should work here:*** Uncapped commission incentives. The more you close, the higher your total compensation.
* Fast\-paced, friendly, competitive environment
* Full benefits – Health, Dental, Vision, 401K
* 3 weeks PTO \+ Paid Holidays
* A culture that celebrates success!

**This describes you:*** Strong hunter mentality.
* Self\-motivated.
* Strong attention to detail and highly organized.


Compensation: $50,000\.00 base, with top reps consistently making $80,000\+ in total compensation. Commissions are paid monthly.  

In addition to our awesome culture, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health and well\-being of you and your family. Our benefits include health insurance options such as medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, and life and AD\&D insurance. We also provide a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, commuter benefits as well as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and well\-being coaching services. In addition, employees can take advantage of voluntary benefits such as home, auto and pet insurance, and discounted legal and financial services. For more details, feel free to inquire during the interview process.  

Internet Brands®, headquartered in El Segundo, Calif, is a fully integrated online media and software services company focused on four high\-value vertical categories: Health, Automotive, Legal, and Home/Travel. The company's properties and platforms include the WebMD, Medscape, and Henry Schein ONE networks, which are the global leaders in their markets; Nolo, Avvo, and Martindale, which form the largest consumer information provider in the legal market; and CarsDirect, Fodor's Travel, and many others which are leaders in their key vertical markets. Internet Brands' award\-winning consumer websites lead their categories and serve more than 250 million monthly visitors, while a full range of web presence offerings has established deep, long\-term relationships with SMB and enterprise clients. The company's powerful, proprietary operating platform provides the flexibility and scalability to fuel the company's continued growth. Internet Brands is a portfolio company of KKR and Warburg Pincus.  

Internet Brands and its wholly owned affiliates are an equal opportunity employer.  

For more information, please visit www.internetbrands.com. Internet Brands and its wholly owned affiliates are an equal opportunity employer.
Notice to California residents: you can find information about our privacy practices, on: https://www.internetbrands.com/work\-with\-us/cpra

jobs.description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about driving brand growth through innovative digital strategies? We are seeking a dynamic and energetic **Digital Marketing Manager** to lead our online marketing initiatives. In this role, you will craft compelling digital campaigns, optimize online presence, and leverage cutting\-edge tools to maximize engagement and conversions. Your expertise will help elevate our brand across multiple digital channels, ensuring we stay ahead in a competitive landscape. Join us to shape impactful marketing experiences that resonate with audiences worldwide!

**Duties**

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About HungryPanda / 关于熊猫外卖**

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London, HungryPanda connects people with authentic Chinese and Asian food through its delivery platform. We work with restaurants, grocery businesses, and local teams to help more people discover the food they love.

Our next opportunity in the U.S. is to make HungryPanda known and used by a wider audience. We are looking for a marketing leader who can see the bigger picture, build a plan for growth, and work hands\-on with the team to make it happen.

熊猫外卖成立于 2017 年，总部位于伦敦。我们通过外卖平台连接消费者与正宗的中华及亚洲美食，并与餐厅、零售商家及本地团队合作，让更多人发现喜爱的美食。

在美国，我们希望让更广泛的消费者认识并使用 HungryPanda。我们正在寻找一位既有全局视角、又愿意亲自投入执行的市场负责人，带领团队把增长计划变成实际成果。

**About the Role / 岗位介绍**

You will lead digital marketing for the U.S. market, with a clear goal: help more people discover HungryPanda, place their first order, and keep coming back. You will build on our connection with Chinese\-speaking communities while finding effective ways to reach a broader U.S. audience.

This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will set priorities and guide the team, while staying close to campaign planning, channel tests, creative work, and performance data. You should be comfortable making strategic decisions and rolling up your sleeves to improve execution.

你将负责美国市场的数字营销工作，目标明确：让更多消费者认识 HungryPanda、完成首次下单，并愿意持续使用。你需要在服务好现有华语用户群体的基础上，探索如何有效触达更广泛的美国消费者。

这是一个需要亲自参与执行的管理岗位。你将确定方向、带领团队，同时深入参与活动策划、渠道测试、内容创意和数据复盘。我们希望你既能做出有依据的策略判断，也能与团队一起把执行做好。

**What You’ll Do / 工作职责**

* **Build a U.S. growth plan.** Identify priority audiences and markets, set clear acquisition and retention goals, and decide where marketing time and budget will have the greatest impact.制定美国市场增长计划。 明确重点用户及城市，设定用户获取与留存目标，并判断团队精力和营销预算应投入在哪里。
* **Bring HungryPanda to a wider audience.** Develop messaging and campaigns that make the platform relevant to Chinese\-speaking customers and to other U.S. consumers interested in Asian food. Test what helps new audiences understand, trust, and try the service.让更多消费者接受 HungryPanda。 针对华语用户，以及对亚洲美食感兴趣的更广泛美国消费者，制定合适的传播内容和活动，测试哪些方式能促使新用户了解、信任并尝试平台。
* **Lead channels and campaigns hands\-on.** Guide work across Xiaohongshu (RED), Instagram, WeChat communities, TikTok, paid digital channels, and other relevant platforms. Get directly involved in briefs, creative reviews, launches, and improvements when needed.亲自参与渠道及活动执行。 统筹小红书、Instagram、微信社群、TikTok、付费数字渠道及其他合适的平台；根据需要亲自参与需求制定、内容审核、上线及优化。
* **Turn awareness into orders.** Work with Product, Operations, and local teams to understand the customer journey, improve first\-order conversion, and create reasons for customers to order again.把品牌认知转化为订单。 与产品、运营及本地团队协作，了解用户从看到广告到完成下单的过程，改善首单转化，并推动复购。
* **Build effective creator and community programs.** Develop KOL/KOC, creator, and community partnerships that fit different audiences and markets; measure their contribution beyond views and engagement alone.建立有效的达人及社群合作。 针对不同用户和城市开展 KOL/KOC、内容创作者及社群合作，并关注其对实际业务增长的贡献。
* **Connect national direction with local execution.** Partner with City Managers and local Marketing teams to adapt campaigns to each market’s customers, merchants, and opportunities.结合全国方向与本地执行。与城市经理及本地市场团队合作，根据各城市的用户、商家和市场机会调整活动。
* **Use data to make decisions.** Track campaign spend and results, including customer acquisition, first orders, repeat orders, and channel performance. Run tests, share what works, and change course when results fall short.用数据指导决策。 跟踪活动投入与效果，包括新用户获取、首单、复购及渠道表现；通过测试总结有效做法，并及时调整效果不佳的方案。
* **Lead and develop the team.** Set clear priorities, coach team members, coordinate external partners, and maintain a high standard of execution across projects.带领并培养团队。 明确工作重点、指导团队成员、协调外部合作方，并确保各项目的执行质

**What You Bring / 任职要求**

* Strong experience in digital or growth marketing for a consumer platform, marketplace, food delivery business, or other consumer brand, including experience leading people or cross\-functional work.具备消费平台、交易平台、外卖业务或其他消费品牌的数字营销或增长营销经验，并有带领团队或跨部门项目的经历。
* A track record of growing an audience and connecting marketing activity to measurable outcomes such as customer acquisition, first purchases, or retention.有扩大用户群体的实际成果，并能说明营销工作如何推动新用户获取、首次购买或留存。
* Ability to set a clear strategy and manage budgets, while remaining comfortable working directly on campaigns, creative, channel tests, and performance reviews.能够制定清晰策略、管理预算，同时愿意亲自参与活动、内容、渠道测试和效果复盘。
* A strong understanding of Chinese\-speaking communities in the U.S., along with curiosity and sound judgment about how to reach a broader American audience.深入了解美国华语用户群体，同时有能力和判断力探索如何触达更广泛的美国消费者。
* Strong analytical, communication, and team leadership skills. Comfortable working with City Managers and teams across different functions.具备良好的数据分析、沟通和团队管理能力，能够与城市经理及不同职能团队有效合作。
* Fluency in spoken and written Mandarin Chinese and English is required.必须能流利使用普通话和英语进行口头及书面工作沟通。

If you enjoy building a growth strategy and getting close to the work that brings it to life, we’d love to hear from you.

如果你既喜欢制定增长方向，也愿意深入一线推动执行，欢迎加入我们，一起让更多美国消费者认识并选择 HungryPanda！

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Mandarin (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Territory Sales Representative at Benco Dental


At Benco Dental, our company is our family, and we are looking for a new addition to assist us in Driving Dentistry Forward. Please review the description below carefully to ensure that this position is the perfect match for you!


**What’s in it for YOU?**


* Excellent Compensation Packages
* Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits Effective on Day 1

* Associate Discounts and Community Giveback Programs
* College Tuition Savings Program
* Caring Family Culture Toward all Associates

* Family owned for 90\+ years

**Position Summary:**

As the **Benco Territory Sales Representative,** youwill drive sales of merchandise, equipment, technology, and Benco services; solicit new business through personal efforts and referrals; maximize the customer experience; enhance selling skills in product and services focus areas; develop healthy/productive working relationships with customers, vendors and Benco teammates. Your role as the Territory Sales Representative is essential in ensuring all transactions are successful and pleasant for all.


**Do YOU Possess These Skills and Attributes?**


* Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to independently stay focused and motivated
* Exceptional time management, organizational, and customer service skills

**Do These Responsibilities Interest YOU?**


* Travel and make regular face\-to\-face sales calls to maintain customer relationships and sales business; lead sales activities with assigned customers; develop strategies, provide information, and answer questions support business goals and sales growth
* Prospect to drive profitable growth and achieve sales goals; add new buying accounts and develop new customer relationships; identify new business through a variety of methods including cold calling and networking
* Lead sales activities with assigned customers and partner with them to build long\-term relationships; Co\-travel with equipment specialists and vendors to uncover opportunities; conduct TRA presentations; Develop a plan to achieve personal \& regional goals for company\-wide promotions
* Partner regularly with vendor reps to continue to learn and gain knowledge about new products. Participate in all sales meetings, dental conventions, team building events and sales training as required
* Identify business needs of clients and leverage Benco’s offering to assist them with a customer\-first mantra
* Develop an in\-depth understanding of our dental products and services in order to provide accurate and detailed information to customers
* Stay updated on dental industry trends, market dynamics, and product and service offerings
* Communicate effectively with regional teammates (equipment sales, service, and inside support) to achieve customer goals and solve customer or internal issues
* Utilize technology and data tools for effective sales calls, opportunities, activity, presentations, publications, and efficient scheduling/follow\-up
* Participate in all sales meetings, dental conventions, team building events and sales training as required
* Identify business needs of clients, and leverage Benco’s offering to assist them with a customer\-first mantra
* Engage in continuous education and learning to become well versed on Benco’s product offering and up to date on the dental industry


**Do YOU Meet These Requirements?**


* Minimum of 2 years of successful sales experience.
* Possess a dependable vehicle, valid driver’s license, and an acceptable driving record.
* Ability to travel in assigned territory daily, as required for customers, vendors and Benco teammates, business and group meetings, and Customer Experience Trips as well as limited overnight travel

Entry level Territory Sales Reps can expect a minimum annualized compensation plan of $75k/year \+ monthly allowance. Our commission structure is unlimited, the more you sell, the more you make (less your draw)!

We provide more supply and equipment options than any other full\-service distributor, an offering enhanced by a comprehensive suite of services, including office design, equipment repair, practice coaching, financing and project management, wealth management and dental\-specific technology solutions. These services are supported by over 400 professionally trained sales representatives and 300 factory\-trained service technicians who begin every task by asking “What does the customer want?”

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager (Aviation)
jobs.description:
**This is an on\-site position stationed in the Los Angeles / Southern California region.**


**About Us:**


Span Construction \& Engineering, Inc. is a pioneer in state\-of\-the\-art prefab steel construction, proudly operating as a 100% Employee Owned Company (ESOP) in the building industry. Since our inception in 1980 we've fostered enduring relationships as trusted advisors with our valued clients. We are the number one builder in our field. We are dedicated to providing exceptional engineering and construction services, having successfully completed over 214 million square feet of buildings to date, with ongoing projects 24/6 throughout the year.


Setting the industry standard, we prioritize safety, quality, and integrity in all our endeavors. We are inspired, challenged, and empowered to be and give our best every day, not only because we are each exceptional at what we do, but also because we are surrounded by hungry, humble and smart people.


**Our Benefits:**


* 100% Employee Owned Company (ESOP)
* Competitive pay
* Per diem paid when working away from home
* Medical benefits and 401K
* Opportunities for career advancement


**About the Role:**


Embark on a dynamic journey of growth and success as an Assistant Project Manager. This hands\-on role provides a unique opportunity to delve into project controls, communications, and the technical intricacies of construction, allowing you to gain invaluable experience and lay the foundation for advancing your career in construction project management. You'll collaborate with the Project Manager and other stakeholders, playing a pivotal role in supporting and driving projects to completion. Your contributions will ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in adherence to the highest quality and safety standards.


**Some of the things you will do as an Assistant Project Manager:**


*Project Planning and Coordination:*


* Assist in the development and maintenance of project schedules, ensuring alignment with project objectives and client expectations.
* Coordinate with various teams, including design, engineering, and construction, to facilitate seamless project execution.


*Document Management:*


* Manage and organize project documentation, including contracts, drawings, specifications, and correspondence.
* Ensure that all project records are accurate, up\-to\-date, and accessible to relevant team members.


*Budget Management:*


* Support the monitoring and control of project budgets, tracking expenses, and identifying potential cost\-saving opportunities.
* Collaborate with the finance team to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.


*Quality Assurance and Safety Compliance:*


* Assist in implementing and maintaining quality assurance and safety programs on construction sites.
* Collaborate with the safety team to ensure adherence to industry standards and company policies.


*Communication:*


* Facilitate effective communication between project stakeholders, including clients, subcontractors, and internal teams.
* Prepare and distribute regular project status reports to keep stakeholders informed of progress and any potential issues.
* Leverage project management software for meticulous control and maintenance of records, including contracts, tracking logs, meeting minutes, and submittals.


*Problem Resolution:*


* Identify and address project issues promptly, working with the Project Manager to develop and implement solutions.
* Collaborate with the construction team to ensure that project challenges are resolved efficiently.


**Some of the things we're looking for in an Assistant Project Manager:**


* SWPPP Certification is a big plus!
* Knowledge of Pre\-Engineered Metal Building / Structural Steel Construction
* Tech savviness with proficiency in project management software (Procore, MS Project) and office productivity software (Office 365 Suite).
* Practical working knowledge of construction\-related documentation and processes, (pre\-planning, scheduling, RFPs/RFIs, change orders, tracking, reporting, closeout, etc.,).
* An exceptional communicator.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the United States.


***Skills and Abilities***


**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering (or related field), or equivalent combination of technical training and related experience.


**Experience:** Advanced knowledge of construction methods, materials, and legal regulations.


Sound experience with the application of physics and mathematics.


**Computer Skills:** Ability to use a PC, tablet, or laptop. Proficient in suite of Microsoft Office products; PowerPoint, Word, Sage PC, BIM 360, and Excel.


**Certifications \& Licenses:** Because this position requires travel, the employee:


* Must have a valid drivers' license.
* Must be able to be insured on the company's insurance policy as a driver for the company.


Must already have or be able to complete requirements for OSHA 30 certification.


**Other Requirements:** Must be able to receive instruction and supervision. Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills. Regular, timely, predictable, and dependable attendance is required. High level of discernment and the ability to communicate the reason to support your decisions and know when/who to involve when changes and problems arise.
