jobs.title: Project Coordinator and Scheduler
jobs.description:
**About BRAVAS**


At BRAVAS, we transform homes into extraordinary living experiences. As the nation’s \#1 luxury technology integrator, we design and deliver premium solutions \- lighting, shades, A/V, networking, home automation, and more, that make life effortless, beautiful, and connected.


We partner with homeowners, architects, builders, and designers on some of the most spectacular homes in the country. And we’re growing.

**The Role**


The Project Coordinator \& Scheduler sits at the center of project execution, supporting Project Managers, coordinating technician schedules across multiple concurrent jobs, and serving as the communication link between clients, field teams, and internal departments. This role is equal parts logistics, coordination, and follow\-through, and embodies our six core values: collaborative, accountable, proactive, curious, passionate, and creative.

**Responsibilities**

* Supports Project Managers with day\-to\-day project activities, documentation, change orders, and milestone tracking.
* Builds and manages installation and technician schedules across multiple projects, assigning resources based on scope, location, and skillset.
* Monitors resource availability and adjusts schedules proactively in response to delays, scope changes, or conflicts.
* Coordinates with warehouse and logistics teams to align technician schedules with material delivery timelines.
* Tracks procurement and ensures timely delivery of equipment and materials to job sites.
* Acts as a central communication point between clients, project managers, subcontractors, and field teams.
* Schedules client meetings, site walks, and punch list closeouts; communicates project scope and schedule updates to all stakeholders.
* Produces daily/weekly dispatch summaries, project timeline updates, resource utilization reports, and closeout documentation.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience in project coordination, scheduling, or operations; construction, technology, or field services a plus.
* Proficiency with scheduling tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Asana, or Monday.com.
* Experience with ERP or project management platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, or Procore.
* Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for scheduling, reporting, and tracking.
* Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Clear communicator, able to work effectively with technicians, managers, and clients alike.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a desk or computer.
* Occasional travel to job sites for scheduling coordination and site walks.

**Bravas Benefits**

* Be part of something premium: Work with the nation’s leader in smart home integration.
* Collaborative culture: A fun, supportive team that celebrates wins together.
* Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to the luxury design/build community and grow your career in project management.
* Competitive perks: Base salary ($25\-$35/hour)\+ bonuses, medical/dental/vision, 401(k), PTO, and more.

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


Emerging Talent is an important part of how Ramp builds for the long term. It gives us the opportunity to meet exceptional people early, build relationships before they enter the broader talent market, and develop the next generation of Ramp talent.


We’re hiring an Emerging Talent Operations Associate to help run the operational foundation behind our internship and new\-grad programs. You’ll partner with recruiters, coordinators, hiring managers, People Ops, and IT to keep candidate data, interviews, offers, onboarding, and intern support moving smoothly.


You’ll help create an exceptional experience from a candidate’s first interaction with Ramp through offer and, for interns, potential conversion to full\-time. This is a hands\-on role for someone organized and resourceful who enjoys making complex programs feel seamless. As you learn the work, you’ll help improve processes, templates, and simple automations.

**This is a temporary, full\-time role with strong potential to convert to a permanent full\-time position.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Support daily operations across the internship and new\-grad recruiting lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate candidate, event, and program data in Ashby.
* Partner with recruiting coordinators on candidate communications during high\-volume periods.
* Support job and offer administration, including requisitions, approvals, and documentation.
* Help coordinate onboarding, access, housing, and other intern and new\-hire needs.
* Track recurring work, flag risks early, and keep important details from slipping.
* Improve team templates, checklists, and operating processes.
* Identify repetitive work that could be simplified with AI or practical automation.
* During slower operational periods, support program management.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent or program operations, university recruiting, events, or another detail\-heavy service role. Equivalent experience is welcome.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Clear, warm communication, timely updates, and reliable follow\-through.
* Comfort managing shifting priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Curiosity about learning new tools and improving how work gets done.
* Good judgment, ownership, and a habit of raising issues early.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Ashby, Greenhouse, or another applicant\-tracking system.
* Familiarity working with Talent, People Ops, IT, Workplace, or Payroll.
* Experience improving a process, tracker, template, or workflow.

*Don’t check every box? We’d still love to hear from you. Care, curiosity, and strong follow\-through matter most.*

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**
------------------

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi

-------------------------

**Design Your Future at PVH**


Design Development Coordinator \- PVH
The Design Development Coordinator drives the product development and commercialization process working with the internal/external cross functional partners (Design, Merch Planning, Raw Materials, Technical Design, Supply, Hub, Factory, Sales and Operations) to deliver product that meets business requirements for quality, aesthetic and price. * Responsible for all daily communication with overseas offices
* Drive product development calendar adherence
* Build effective relationships with internal partners in Design, Sales, Merchandise Planning, and Supply and Operations to help execute cross functional synergy and collaboration

* 1\-3 years’ experience recommended in product development, merchandising or other related work experience
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong sense of teamwork and ability to multitask
* Work independently

* Detail oriented and ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* High energy level and must work well under pressure

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

  


**Job Overview**

  



The Seasonal Parade Studio Assistant assists the Parade Studio \& Production Management Teams in various aspects of production for the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, as well as providing project management and general office support.

  


**What You Will Do**

  


* Support the Project Management process on cross\-functional projects
* Schedule meetings, trainings, deliveries, and ticket distributions
* Assist with shipping and dropping off deliveries and supplies
* Prepare and update RSVP lists, sign\-in sheets, and security lists

	+ Reaching, including above eye level
	+ Involves close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions

  


**What We Can Offer You**

  



Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

jobs.title: Administrative Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

IMPORTANT NOTE: CANDIDATES MUST HAVE A PERMANENT PRINCIPAL ADMINISTRATIVE ASSOCIATE CIVIL SERVICE TITLE OR ARE PERMANENT IN A COMPARABLE CIVIL SERVICE TITLE ELIGIBLE FOR A 6\.1\.9 TITLE CHANGE.  

  

PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR EMPLOYEE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER (EIN) WHEN APPLYING AND INDICATE IN YOUR COVER LETTER YOUR PERMANENT CIVIL SERVICE TITLE.  

  

NYC Department of Finance (DOF) is responsible for administering the tax revenue laws of the city fairly, efficiently, and transparently to instill public confidence and encourage compliance while providing exceptional customer service.  

  

DOF’s The Tax Audit and Enforcement Division is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by New York City. The division conducts audits related to corporate, personal, sales, and use taxes. City tax auditors conduct audits of selected audit candidates with a goal of determining the appropriate tax liability of each taxpayer and applying NYC rules and laws in accordance with the City’s policies and procedures.  

  

The Office of Tax Audit is charged with the audit of all business and excise taxes administered by the City of New York. Tax Audit conducts audits of general corporation tax, business corporation tax, commercial rent tax, unincorporated business tax, hotel tax, utility tax, real property transfer tax, and bank tax. Tax Audit also conducts NYC personal income tax and sales and use tax audits within New York City. jobs.title: Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**STARR Restaurants** is seeking an ambitious, organized, and hospitality\-minded **Events Coordinator** to join our amazing team in New York City. This position is largely remote, but requires flexibility to meet onsite as business demands.


Working closely with our Senior Director of Events and Event Sales Managers, this position provides hands\-on administrative and coordination support for a diverse portfolio of affiliated STARR Restaurants, including:


Buddakan NY \| Pastis NY \| Le Café Louis Vuitton \| Le Coucou \| Babbo \| The Clocktower \| Electric Lemon \| El Vez \| Upland


We are looking for someone who is proactive, detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and ready to take ownership. For the right candidate, this is more than a coordinator position — it is an opportunity to learn from experienced event professionals, demonstrate your capabilities, and grow into greater responsibility within the organization.

 **This position offers a comprehensive package including:**

* Base Salary Range of $70,000–$80,000
* Paid Vacation and Sick Time
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits Coverage
* Referral Bonus Programs
* Dining Discounts at 25\+ affiliated STARR Restaurants

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support Event Sales Managers with day\-to\-day event sales and administrative needs.
* Respond to and qualify incoming event inquiries, including checking availability, suggesting alternative dates, and cross\-selling affiliated STARR Restaurant venues.
* Maintain accurate event bookings and availability across reservation and event\-management platforms.
* Maintain **Tripleseat**, including event details, menus, beverage selections, and picklists.
* Prepare and distribute weekly BEO packets and daily final BEOs to Restaurant Managers, Chefs, and relevant hospitality partners.
* Cross\-check BEOs against reservation platforms to ensure accuracy of dates, times, and event details.
* Communicate with Restaurant Managers, Chefs, Beverage Managers, and other internal teams regarding event availability, approvals, menus, and operational details.
* Maintain and update event menus in collaboration with Chefs and Event Sales Managers.
* Create customized event menus and collateral using **Adobe InDesign**.
* Assist with vendor coordination, including Certificates of Insurance, security requirements, and load\-in logistics.
* Assist with party rental orders and other event\-related logistics.
* Support Event Sales initiatives including competitive analysis, marketing projects, and departmental special projects.
* Provide additional support to the Events team as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* **2–3\+ years of experience** in event sales, event coordination, hospitality, restaurants, hotels, catering, or a related field.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong follow\-through and the ability to anticipate needs.
* Professional and confident when communicating with management, culinary teams, vendors, and clients.
* Experience with **Tripleseat** or another event\-management/CRM platform preferred.
* Experience with **OpenTable, Resy**, or other restaurant reservation platforms.
* Working knowledge of **Adobe InDesign**; experience creating menus or event collateral strongly preferred.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office and Google Workspace**.
* Hospitality\-minded with a polished, professional, and service\-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple restaurants and departments.

*Equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

jobs.title: Start-up / Field Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Extend is building document processing infrastructure for the most technical AI teams to work with unstructured data (e.g. PDFs, Excel, images, etc.). AI teams at companies like Square, Zillow, Brex, Flatiron Health, Checkr, and Mercury use Extend to process their most complex documents.


We're looking for a Start\-up / Field Marketing Lead at Extend. You will own the mandate of field and conference marketing, but most importantly, we are looking for someone who makes sure every startup and developer knows Extend and thinks of us because of the events and physical presence we build. Awareness takes a long time to turn into a signup or a booked demo, and being IRL, month after month, is how we'll drive it.


We care far more about slope than years of experience. We're looking for someone who can project\-manage the hell out of an event, stays unflappable when things break, and genuinely loves planning IRL events and being part of the startup community.

**Why you should consider joining**
-----------------------------------

* We've grown revenue 6x YoY with our growth continuing to accelerate (8 figures, 200%\+ NRR)
* We have a product loved by users and being used in mission\-critical flows at enterprises (Square, Zillow, Chime) and startups (Brex, Mercury, Checkr), and many more
* The market for document processing has expanded 1000x due to LLMs, and all existing solutions are low NPS
* We're punching well above our weight, supporting customer and revenue metrics with half the team size of other startups — everyone joining at this stage will have outsized impact
* We've raised our Series A, de\-risked the business, and our sales team has exceeded quota every quarter, but there's still tremendous upside ahead; now's the perfect time to join
* You'll be joining a talent dense team, operating in a high performance culture, in\-person in NYC, with high equity ownership
* You'll get a front row seat to how a successful startup is built, with plenty of leadership opportunities as we grow quickly

**Role and Impact**
-------------------

* **Expand Extend’s field footprint and brand awareness** in SF and NYC via creative, fun, and well\-curated events in both locations. Think bold.
* **Activate the startup community:** YC and Demo Day events, co\-hosted events with partners, founder dinners — whatever makes every startup know and think of Extend
* **Support conference execution:** project\-manage Extend's conference presence end to end — booth build, shipping logistics, staffing, run\-of\-show, and follow\-up — so the team shows up ready and nothing gets figured out on the day
* **Make people stop:** design booths and activations that get people to stop, engage, and remember us — tasteful, never generic B2B
* **Make events bigger than the room:** produce for social so an event reaches people who weren't there
* **Tie IRL to pipeline:** connect events to signups and booked meetings so we know what's working and where to double down

**Ideal Candidate Credentials**
-------------------------------

* 1\+ years of experience. We're hiring for slope, not years. Great backgrounds include VC (platform, chief of staff, or community), event or field marketing, production, SDR or growth roles with a lot of event work, and chief of staff roles
* You love planning IRL events, not just attending them, and you're already part of the startup community: you're on X, you know founders, and you have strong opinions about what makes a good event
* You break an event into workstreams, keep every stakeholder on track, and see the blind spots before they show up
* You're warm, extroverted, and not afraid of rejection: you'll say good morning to every person who walks past the booth, and a "no thank you" doesn't slow you down
* You bring creative, unconventional ideas that cut through the noise at events where everyone else looks the same
* Experience managing the conference lifecycle: event selection, sponsorships, booth or activation strategy, speaking opportunities, meeting generation, onsite logistics, and post\-event pipeline follow\-up.
* Based in NYC and willing to travel to SF often

**Benefits**
------------


Beyond the below, we care deeply about each of our candidates on a personal level. We take the time to understand your needs to craft a package designed for you:

* Insurance — 100% health insurance premium coverage
* Relocation — for candidates based outside of NYC
* Unlimited PTO policy — we trust everyone like owners, take what you need
* Daily lunch \& snacks covered (plus dinner if you're in the office late) — you'll never go hungry and you help pick the snacks
* Unlimited token / tooling access — no handicaps on your productivity
* Learning and development investment — we invest heavily in our team and support your growth


Extend is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Live Events Production Coordinator, The Greene Space
jobs.description:
The Jerome L. Greene Performance Space at WNYC \& WQXR is looking for a **Live Events Production Coordinator** to join our The Green Space (TGS). The Greene Space is the live public embodiment of WNYC, WQXR and WNYC Studios' shows, as well as a producer of our own original programming . We produce 50\+ programs each season for in house and digital audiences, including discussions, debates, concerts, game shows, podcast tapings, and theatrical productions. The Greene Space also operates as a rental venue, hosting events for external clients and partners.  

The **Live Events Production Coordinator** supports the planning and execution of live events, including ticketed programming, show events, internal events, and rentals. Working closely with the Director of Event Operations and the rest of the Events team, show teams, clients, and internal partners, the Coordinator helps ensure events are well organized, properly staffed, and successfully executed from initial planning through event wrap. This position reports to the Director of Events and Venue Operations.  

Our live events producers must have relevant production experience along with excellent judgment, ability to manage competing deadlines, strong verbal and written communication skills, team spirit, and good humor. Join us if you’re curious, unflappable, able to thrive in a dynamic and evolving environment, and ready to do whatever it takes because “the show must go on” – and this can include anything from landing a big guest to unloading the dishwasher.
Previous experience in live events is strongly preferred, but flexibility and willingness to learn is prized above all. **RESPONSIBILITIES**
Under the supervision of the Director of Events and Venue Operations, the Coordinator is responsible for learning all aspects of the live event space, including:  

LIVE EVENT PRODUCTION:* Coordinate the planning and execution of live events, rentals, and special programming, supporting projects from initial planning through day\-of production and post\-event wrap.
* Maintain timeline, run\-of\-show documents, production schedules, and event checklists.
* Serve as a point of contact for internal show teams, external clients, talent, and vendors, helping communicate schedules, requirements, and event details.
* Coordinate event logistics, including staffing, catering, security, facilities, equipment, guest and comp lists, ticketing, and other event needs.
* Work closely with technical and production staff to confirm audio, video, lighting, staging, recording, and livestream requirements as needed.
* Provide on\-site event support, including load\-in, setup, client and talent needs, audience arrival, event execution, and breakdown.
* Provide additional production and operational support as the live\-events portfolio grows.

  

MARKETING/PROMOTION:* Coordinate with Audience, Marketing, Social, Development, Sponsorship, Membership, and show teams to support event promotion, audience development, and revenue opportunities.

  

ADMIN:* Support ticketing and attendance tracking, including monitoring sales, comps, capacity, and final attendance.
* Assist in admin responsibilities, including issuing SLAs, tracking invoices \& expenses, vendor contracts, and financial reconciliation.
* Maintain the events calendar, Airtable/database, production documentation, and event assets, ensuring information is accurate and accessible across teams and on the website..
* Support compliance with venue and organizational requirements, including insurance, accessibility, fire and safety regulations, and alcohol permitting where applicable.
* Conduct post\-event wrap\-ups and help track attendance, revenue, expenses, audience insights, and other key learnings.
* Coordinate food and beverage orders
* Partner with the Director of Events Operations and Sr. Director of Operations to audit, document and improve event workflows and contribute to maintaining an events production playbook.

 **Qualifications*** Strong organizational and project coordination skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills and comfort working with clients, talent, producers, vendors, and technical teams.
* Enthusiasm for a live production environment that sometimes requires shifting gears quickly or pressure to meet deadlines
* Ability to think critically, creatively, and proactively solve problems
* High EQ: You are intuitive and can easily work with and for diverse people with different capabilities and needs, whether they’re colleagues, talent, or audience members
* Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, calendars, databases, budgets, and project\-management tools.
* Love for live performance, art, and journalism and a commitment to highlighting the work of BIPOC artists and journalists
* Experience working for a media or performing arts organization is preferred
* Experience with event production, venue operations, ticketing, or live audio/video production is preferred.
* Availability to work evenings and occasional weekends based on the event schedule.

  

Additional Information

As a Wholesale Account Coordinator, you will be at the center of one of Levi's most important wholesale partnerships, helping bring products, strategies, and seasonal launches to life for the Macy's business. Working alongside Account Managers and cross\-functional partners, you'll drive order execution, support product launches, analyze business performance, and help solve challenges that impact the customer experience. You'll gain broad exposure across the wholesale business while contributing to a high\-profile account and learning from a collaborative team and manager committed to mentorship and development.

* **Sales Support:** Partner with the Account Managers and sales team to execute account strategies, support seasonal business initiatives, and contribute to achieving sales and growth objectives.

* **Order Management:** Manage order entry, planned unit maintenance, and purchase order tracking from placement through fulfillment. Partner with internal teams and retail customers to resolve order, inventory, delivery, and credit\-related issues while supporting on\-time and accurate product delivery.
* **Sample \& Product Management:** Own the end\-to\-end coordination of seasonal and in\-season samples, including ordering, tracking, inventory management, showroom readiness, and internal and external distribution.
* **Sales Analysis \& Reporting:** Prepare and maintain weekly, monthly, quarterly, and seasonal sales, shipping, and performance reports. Analyze business trends and provide insights that support account planning.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with Planning, Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service teams to support account objectives, resolve issues, and drive business execution.
* **Market \& Retail Insights:** Monitor retail trends, competitive activity, pricing, product placement, and in\-store execution to support account planning and identify opportunities within the marketplace.
* You will report to the Senior Account Manager, Macy's

 **About You**

* **Relevant Experience:** 3\+ years of experience in wholesale, retail, merchandising, sales support, sales operations, customer operations, or a related consumer products environment.
* **Order \& Business Operations:** Experience supporting order management, purchase order processes, inventory coordination, account operations, or related business processes.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Ability to work with sales, inventory, shipping, or business performance data to identify trends, monitor results, and support decision\-making.
* **Collaborator:** Experience partnering with stakeholders across multiple functions to coordinate activities, resolve issues, and support business objectives.
* **Prioritization \& Execution:** Ability to manage competing priorities, follow established processes, and adapt to changing needs. Manage multiple deliverables that require accuracy, organization, and adherence to deadlines.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (ie utilizing functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), data analysis tools and a basic understanding of retail math
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

  

This is a hybrid work schedule based in our New York, New York office. You will be expected in office 3 days per week typically Tuesday\-Thursday. Note, time in office can vary depending on business needs.

jobs.description:

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. In this position, you will act as the bridge between customers and operations, ensuring seamless service delivery, driving process improvements, and implementing tailored solutions that meet client needs.

* Customer\-focused and solution\-oriented mindset
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret KPI data and drive improvements
* Ability to work independently with strong organizational and prioritization skills
* Experience in process documentation, standardization, and continuous improvement

At Kuehne\+Nagel we strive daily to inspire, empower, and deliver not only to our customers, but also to our colleagues. Base salary is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes health and welfare benefits, a 401k retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, and incentive compensation for eligible roles. Who we are
  
  

Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

You'll run point on incoming RFPs and agency briefs, building the proposals, media plans, and pitches that turn interest into revenue, working side by side with our sales leads across travel, financial, and lifestyle categories. Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high\-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses,a joint venture in the health services industry,and strategic investments in Europe. jobs.title: Account Manager for Internal Creative Agency
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**About Skyline**
-----------------


Skyline is Citi’s U.S. internal creative agency — a full\-service partner offering Strategy, Creative, Data \& Insights, AI, and Operations capabilities to business partners across the firm. Skyline's purpose is to help Citi's businesses communicate more effectively, reach their audiences, and demonstrate measurable impact. As Skyline evolves, the Account Management function is expanding its remit: moving upstream from campaign execution to strategic partnership, and from project facilitation to proactive internal intelligence and opportunity development.


**Role Purpose**
----------------


The Strategic Account Manager builds strong, proactive partnerships between Skyline and its internal marketing partners by developing a deep understanding of marketing partners business priorities, translating those priorities into creative and strategic opportunities, and connecting marketing partners with the right Skyline capabilities across Creative, Data \& Insights, and Operations. This role serves as the strategic bridge between the marketing partners and Skyline — helping the agency move upstream from receiving requests to identifying needs, shaping solutions, and demonstrating the value Skyline delivers across the account.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Internal Client Partnership \& Intelligence**


* Build and maintain trusted stakeholder relationships across assigned internal business partners, engaging beyond individual projects to develop a holistic understanding of the marketing partners’ business
* Develop deep knowledge of the internal client's objectives, upcoming priorities, audience needs, decision\-making environment, and organizational dynamics
* Capture and document relevant partner signals, recurring needs, challenges, and emerging priorities to maintain a consolidated, living view of the account
* Bring internal client intelligence back into Skyline to inform planning, capability development, and proactive outreach

### **Opportunity Development**


* Identify opportunities where Skyline can become involved earlier in the marketing partners planning cycle or provide broader, more integrated support
* Maintain the account Opportunity Tracker, capturing outreach activity, potential work, expected business impact, and next actions
* Connect opportunities across teams, products, and lines of business where appropriate
* Partner with Strategy, Creative and Data \& Insights to develop proactive recommendations
* Support the appropriate growth of the account relationship and help reduce unnecessary reliance on external agencies

### **Strategic Intake \& Solution Shaping**


* Lead intake conversations that help marketing partners clarify the business problem before work moves into execution
* Determine whether a request requires a single deliverable, a broader campaign, research, data support, or a different Skyline solution
* Bring the right Skyline experts into the conversation early to shape the response
* Improve brief quality by ensuring objectives, audience, desired outcomes, context, and measures of success are clearly defined before handoff to delivery teams
* Constructively challenge or redirect requests when a different approach would create greater value for our marketing partners

### **Account Planning \& Governance**


* Maintain a structured account plan covering internal client priorities, stakeholders, active and future work, relationship health, risks, and opportunities
* Lead strategic account reviews focused on intelligence, decisions, opportunities, and risks — distinct from project status updates
* Coordinate with Operations on capacity implications, prioritization, and portfolio\-level visibility
* Escalate account\-level risks proactively, before they affect the relationship or delivery quality
* Contribute account insights to the broader Internal Client Intelligence Hub and to Skyline leadership reporting

### **Value \& Impact Storytelling**


* Partner with Data \& Insights and Operations to capture and communicate evidence of Skyline's business impact
* Connect completed work to measurable business outcomes — including internal client satisfaction, efficiency gains, cost savings, and increased internal adoption
* Help identify potential case studies, proof points, and leadership narratives that demonstrate Skyline's strategic value
* Use account insights and performance information to recommend next steps and future opportunities
* Help marketing partners understand the full value of Skyline's capabilities beyond the individual deliverable

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
-----------------------------------


* Skyline is involved earlier in internal client planning cycles — not only at the point of an execution request
* More opportunities are proactively identified and converted into work, tracked through the Opportunity Tracker
* Marketing partners engage with more Skyline capabilities — not just Creative — reflecting deeper strategic integration
* Strategic account reviews produce decisions and actions, not status updates
* Skyline can demonstrate measurable business value and internal client impact beyond campaign delivery metrics
* Internal client satisfaction and internal adoption improve across assigned accounts
* Account risks and opportunities are visible and addressed at the leadership level before they become issues
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance w

We value the uniqueness of each individual and promote a respectful and supportive work environment.  

  

We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

#### **About us**


BidX offers a software solution for automated and optimized advertising for merchants on Amazon. Through rule\-based and self\-learning algorithms, keyword management and bid adjustments can be automated. This allows sellers and vendors to use their advertising budgets more efficiently, increase their profits, and significantly reduce their workload. Relative advertising costs are reduced by an average of 32 percent in the first 8 weeks alone. Numerous international retailers and agencies from 42 countries already rely on the BidX software solution.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
#### **\#Team****Nextdoor**



Nextdoor (NYSE: KIND) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at **nextdoor.com**.


#### **Meet your Future** **Neighbors**



Nextdoor Account Managers are a diverse, driven, and strategic group of client services and salespeople focused on connecting brands with our community of neighbors through our growing portfolio of advertising products. The team culture mirrors the larger business focus, relying on building trusted relationships both internally as well as with our partners. The team drives results for our brand partners while creating neighbor value. We're a purpose\-driven company and we're recruiting like\-minded client services professionals who are as passionate about customer value as they are professional growth, and building a culture of belonging.



At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we're looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI\-assisted outputs.



We also offer a warm and inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending an in office presence and work from home experience for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London.


#### **The** **Impact** **You'll Make**



Nextdoor's Account Management team helps advertisers by connecting them with our hyper\-local community of neighbors across the United States through our native advertising platform. We are seeking a results\-oriented Account Manager to join the Advertising Solutions team and grow our advertising partnerships on Nextdoor. You'll work with brands and agencies to execute buys on the platform, while also partnering with product management and engineering teams to provide feedback and identify opportunities to improve the efficacy of our product. You'll bring a passion for driving customer value and business outcomes, with a track record of retaining and growing customer relationships.


**Your responsibilities will include:**


* Manage all aspects of an advertiser's platform buy, from customer onboarding to campaign execution
* Build and manage strong partnerships with brand and agency partners; own day\-to\-day communication to ensure campaign success
* Provide excellent customer service by proactively monitoring campaign delivery and performance, and solving campaign\-related issues in a timely manner
* Own data\-driven upsell and renewal conversations to retain and grow advertising partnerships
* Leverage internal tools and dashboards to analyze and optimize performance
* Be a platform expert; cultivate a strategic approach to product adoption through deep knowledge of your customer's business challenges and our platform's solutions
* Create and present strategic POVs, campaign wrap\-ups and/or Quarterly Business Reviews to clients
* Work cross\-functionally to ensure all aspects of a campaign are executed flawlessly
* Participate in in\-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off\-sites, volunteer days, and team building exercises
* Build in\-person relationships with team members and contribute to Nextdoor's company culture

#### **What You'll Bring To The Team**


* 2\-5 years of experience in account management or client services at a digital media/advertising company or agency
* Strong understanding of campaign strategy, execution, and optimization within a platform\-based media buying environment with both, managed and self\-service clients
* Track record of successfully retaining and growing customer relationships
* Hands\-on experience optimizing brand awareness and lower\-funnel performance KPIs
* Curiosity, hunger to learn, and passion for problem\-solving
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced and high\-volume environment; manage multiple projects while maintaining strong attention to detail
* Data\-driven and analytical mindset; deliver actionable insights to drive strategy and renewals
* A passion for community building, to inspire a more inclusive team and diversity of thought, both at Nextdoor and in your own neighborhoods
* Eagerness to explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done

#### **Rewards**



Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.



The compensation range for this role includes a base salary \+ commission structure with a 70/30 split. Commission will vary depending on your achievement of sales\-related goals and objectives. The budgeted OTE **inclusive of base \+ commission** is in the range of $110,000 \- $135,000 (base salary of $77,000 \- $94,500\) on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate's geographic location.



We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date.



When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care.

jobs.title: Community Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



As a Community Account Manager, you will be assigned a portfolio of muti\-dwelling unit properties. The primary responsibility as CAM, is to grow and maintain market share by selling new movers, win\-back customers, and upgrade existing customers to maximize monthly recurring revenue. Additionally, our CAM, will develop and manage the onsite relationship with the leasing staff, to ensure we are maximizing the terms of our marketing agreement, driving growth through educating staff and residents about the value of our products and reliability of our service, while positioning Optimum favorably against competitors and for contract renewals. In this role, you will be assigned new properties ensuring we maximize MDU new build customer penetration by working with onsite sales personnel and internal field operations to be “first to the door”.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Consistent achievement of monthly sales, revenue quotas and key performance indicators.
* Coordinate marketing events and cultivate relationships with sales, leasing staff and HOA's representing our brand, products while providing service excellence.
* Conduct site and virtual visits with property staff, updating and replenishing sales collateral, and educating leasing staff about new and existing product offers and the value of the optimum brand.
* Schedule quarterly/semi\-annual reviews with property staff to “walk” the property, understand business trends and share property performance against established targets.
* Act as a liaison between property management and our internal Technical Operations, Construction Department and Sales Support to address service issues that impacts our ability to deliver on\-time and exceptional service.
* Timely tracking and reporting of all sales, events, visits, and property escalations.
* Act as a point of contact with Bulk Property management staff, coordinating new customer onboarding and de\-bulk events.
* All other duties assigned by your supervisor.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* 5\+ years related experience.
* Ability to travel up to 75%
* Strong communication skills are a must.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite programs is required.
* Business Development experience with emphasis on new customer acquisition and relationship management.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Computer skills, including Windows\-based applications, and the ability to work within Salesforce and sales order entry and CRM platforms.
* Strong people and relationship management skills.
* Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license in good standing within the state of current residence.


At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stops.

  

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

  

All job descriptions and required skills, qualifications and responsibilities for a particular position are subject to modification by the Company from time to time, in the Company’s discretion based on business necessity.

  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to recruiting, hiring and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds regardless of gender, race, color, creed, national origin, religion, age, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

This information is collected for employment purposes, including identification, work authorization, FCRA\-compliant background screening, human resource administration and compliance with federal, state and local law.

  

Applicants for employment with The Company will never be asked to provide money (even if reimbursable) as part of the job application or hiring process. Please review our Fraud FAQ for further details.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with advertising sales, business development, online media environment, or sales\-oriented marketing roles.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in the financial industry with knowledge of and established relationships within the advertising and tech industries.
* Expert knowledge and achievement in Brand and Performance marketing and media operations and sales.
* Knowledge of traditional and contemporary/online marketing tactics and strategy.
* Significant record of collaborative, humble, and others\-empowering leadership style resulting in support from peers and managers.
* Record of success building relationships with and selling to middle managers through executives at the global enterprises.
* Material quantitative and technical skills relevant to digital and traditional media strategy, planning, buying, and measurement.

**About the job**
-----------------


Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.



Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how
  

Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market\-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $88000 \- $124000 (USD) \+ 35% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Optimize business growth potential and enhance growth across the client portfolio.
* Understand key clients business goals and current video, display, and search advertising strategies.
* Develop forward thinking, data\-driven analyses and consultative recommendations that align with customer goals, and quantify high\-impact opportunities with clear recommendations to present to customers.
* Respond to media briefs and RFPs, identifying and presenting opportunities.
* Act as a liaison with clients and agencies regarding new product launches and advertising opportunities and manage ongoing customer training and collateral.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Sales Account Manager, US LCS, CPG
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of advertising solutions. We partner with advertisers to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high quality sites across the web, and on millions of devices. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world\-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  

  

We’re looking for a results oriented Account Manager who is passionate about partnering with our advertisers, educating them and helping to solve ambiguous business problems, mitigating risks before they become roadblocks. As an Account Manager, you manage and deliver against complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue and achieve revenue targets. You nurture customer relationships and create revenue opportunities from the advertisers you own. You’ll not only dive deep into data to understand trends, but also communicate the “why” behind results and make actionable recommendations to internal and external stakeholders. Additionally, you’ll be able to leverage Amazon’s proprietary data to provide strategic and personalized recommendations, influencing both your internal team and your external customer to facilitate them reaching their business goals. This role is highly collaborative, working with Creative, Senior Sales, Product, and Retail partners and will drive process improvement to gain efficiency and foster collaboration. The Senior Account Manager’s strategic digital expertise and influence is considered critical to unlocking greater value and impact for our advertisers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions
* Develop annual brand and media strategies for growth based on overall advertiser goals/objectives
* Develop campaign strategies and audience targeting recommendations per brand and product line
* Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign performance using a data driven approach
* Perform in\-depth data analysis to deliver actionable insights \& recommendations that influence short term / long term digital media strategy
* Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to achieve greater results on Amazon
* Work cross\-functionally with senior sales and other Amazon partners to drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of marketing, brand advertising, media sales or online advertising work and close work with senior advertisers and agency stakeholders experience
* Experience translating technical aspects of analysis and metrics into actionable insights for the advertiser and both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Full Funnel experience in Omni\-channel marketing, display, over\-the\-top (OTT) and search marketing
* Adept at solving problems that span business and technology
* Influence process improvement that scales broadly; inventing and simplifying within existing processes

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 7\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Bachelors’ degree in Economics, Marketing, Advertising, Statistics, Engineering or Business; MBA is a plus
* Excellent organizational, relationship\-building, and communication (written and verbal) skills
* Proven track record of delivering results (including revenue targets) and significantly contributing to advertiser revenue growth

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Build Your Market. Own Your Success.**


*Help us shape the future of plant\-powered wellness.*

  

Vivazen creates plant\-powered products featuring kratom and kava for consumers seeking effective alternatives. Our products are already available in more than 70,000 retail locations nationwide and we are just getting started!

  

We are expanding into new markets, opening new retail channels, and developing new product categories. To accelerate that growth, we are looking for ambitious people who want more than an ordinary job. Vivazen is a small, fast\-moving company where strong performers are trusted, ideas can quickly become action, and individual contributions make a visible difference. If you are energized by growth, motivated by results, and excited by the opportunity to help build what comes next, we would like to meet you.

 **Independent Sales Opportunities**


*Your territory. Your relationships. Your upside.*

  

We are looking for entrepreneurial 1099 sales professionals who know how to open doors, build lasting customer relationships, and turn opportunity into revenue.

  

This is an opportunity for self\-directed salespeople who value independence and want their earning potential to reflect the results they create. You will represent an established brand with significant national retail distribution while helping Vivazen expand into new accounts, channels, and territories.

  

You will have the freedom to develop your market, manage your relationships, and build a meaningful book of business with support from a company that moves quickly and wants its sales partners to win.

 **Why Sell Vivazen?**


*An Established Brand with Room to Grow*

  

Vivazen products can already be found in more than 70,000 retailers across the country. You are not starting with an unknown concept, you are building from an established foundation with substantial growth potential.

 **Performance\-Based Earning Potential**



We believe results should be rewarded. Our independent sales opportunities are designed for motivated producers who want to increase their income by expanding distribution, developing accounts, and driving sales.

 **Freedom to Build**



Take ownership of your territory and determine how you create momentum. We value initiative, resourcefulness, and sales professionals who know their customers and markets.

 **Products with a Compelling Consumer Story**



Represent plant\-powered products in a rapidly evolving wellness category and help retailers respond to growing consumer interest in alternative solutions.

 **Speed and Access**



We are not weighed down by layers of bureaucracy. You will work with a responsive, entrepreneurial organization that can recognize opportunities and act quickly.

 **The Chance to Make an Impact**



At Vivazen, your work will be visible. The relationships you create and the markets you develop will directly contribute to the company’s next stage of growth.

 **You May Be a Great Fit If You Are:**

  

* A proven hunter who enjoys opening new accounts and building a territory
* Entrepreneurial, self\-motivated, and comfortable working independently
* Driven by achievement and energized by performance\-based compensation
* Skilled at developing strong, long\-term retailer and distributor relationships
* Persistent, credible, and confident presenting products to decision\-makers
* Organized and disciplined about pipelines, follow\-up, and account development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving and evolving business
* Knowledgeable about convenience, smoke and vape, specialty retail, grocery, wellness, or related consumer\-product channels
* Committed to responsible selling and operating within all applicable regulatory and brand guidelines

  


**What Success Looks Like**



You identify untapped opportunities, consistently open qualified accounts, and grow productive relationships over time. You understand that great sales performance is not simply about closing an initial order, it is about earning trust, supporting sell\-through, creating repeat business, and building a territory with lasting value.

  

You bring market intelligence back to the business, helping us understand what customers want, where opportunities are emerging, and how Vivazen can continue improving.

  

Most importantly, you take ownership. You do not wait to be managed, you create momentum!

 **More Ways to Grow With Vivazen**



Sales is central to our expansion, but growth requires exceptional people across the business. We also seek talented professionals in operations, marketing, and other commercial functions who are ready to solve problems, improve how we work, and help us enter new categories.

  

Whether you build customer relationships, strengthen our operating capabilities, or bring our brand to life, you will be joining a company where your contribution matters.

 **Ready to Build Something Bigger?**



If you want the freedom to perform, the opportunity to shape a growing market, and a company that recognizes people who deliver, explore our current opportunities.

 **Bring your ambition. Build your market. Grow with Vivazen.**

  



Independent sales roles are 1099 contractor opportunities. Compensation, territory availability, responsibilities, and eligibility requirements vary by position and will be detailed during the selection process.

 **Learn more about us here:** https://vivazen.com/

jobs.description:

Join Planhat's Deployment Strategy (our way of saying Customer Success!) team. Help build the systems our Deployment Strategists run on, support them on the accounts that matter most, and grow into the role yourself.


**Competencies**
----------------


Planhat's Deployment Strategy group is scaling, and this role exists to help it scale well.


This is a supporting role, and it sits at the center of the team. Your primary job is supporting the Director in building the structure that makes our Deployment Strategists effective: planning frameworks, renewal standards, portfolio reporting, account intelligence, and whatever else the group needs as it grows. Alongside that, you support the Deployment Strategists on key accounts. You will not own the structure and you will not own the accounts. You will make both better, and you will learn more in two years than most people do in five. You will not be handed a portfolio on day one. You will earn one.


Experience matters less than drive, ambition, judgment, how fast you learn, and whether you fit how this team works. Most people who succeed here are recent graduates with a record of performing somewhere competitive, or have one to two years in a startup, consultancy or fast\-growth SaaS environment.


* **Structured thinker.** You take an ambiguous situation, break it into parts, and come back with a recommendation rather than a list of questions.
* **Comfortable with data.** A CRM data model, a field mapping or a large spreadsheet doesn't intimidate you. You can tell when customer data is wrong.
* **Disciplined.** You close your commitments without being chased. It is the strongest predictor of success in this role.
* **Credible in writing.** You can write a clear paragraph to a VP. Plain, direct, no filler.
* **Quick learner.** Planhat is a deep product and there are no passengers here, only crew.
* **Self\-directed.** You take initiative without waiting for direction and do well with autonomy and accountability.
* **Ambitious.** You want a career in customer strategy, not a first job.

  

**Trajectory**
--------------


This is the entry point into Deployment Strategy at Planhat, with the objective of transitioning into a full Deployment Strategist role owning a named portfolio.


* **Within days:** product training, account history and internal reviews. Your first weeks are internal.
* **Within the first few months:** you are in the room for executive customer conversations, renewal planning and escalations on accounts most people don't touch until well into their careers. You are there to absorb, not to carry the conversation. The Deployment Strategist owns the relationship and the outcome.
* **Supporting the Director:** you help run the operating rhythm of the Americas team, contribute to the frameworks it runs on, turn portfolio data into something leadership can act on, and pick up the projects that keep getting deprioritized because everyone else is in accounts. The Director sets the direction. You do a lot of the building.
* **Supporting a DS, day to day:** preparing the ground for a renewal with the owning DS, updating account plans and stakeholder maps after a call, pulling together EBR and QBR content that holds up in front of a C\-level audience, and tracking commitments to closure. The DS carries the account. You make sure they walk in prepared.
* **Learning the product:** real fluency in Planhat, built on live customer environments rather than a sandbox, while shadowing every Deployment Strategist on the team.
* **Longer term:** progressively more account\-facing responsibility, then transition to a Deployment Strategist with your own portfolio.

Progression is earned on performance, not tenure.

  

  

**Definition of Success**
-------------------------


* Planhat certified and independently productive in the platform by day 90\.
* Our operating rhythm measurably improves, and the improvement is attributable in part to what you helped build and refine.
* Deployment Strategists trust you inside their live customer environments without checking your work.
* Renewal preparation you contribute to is complete and review\-ready ahead of the 90 day mark, consistently, and the owning DS never has to redo it.
* Deployment Strategists across the team ask for you by name on their hardest accounts.

  

**Compensation**
----------------


The salary range for this position is $50,000 to $60,000 per year. Actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience and performance. The range listed is one component of the company's total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.


Join Planhat's Deployment Strategy (our way of saying Customer Success!) team. Help build the systems our Deployment Strategists run on, support them on the accounts that matter most, and grow into the role yourself.


**Competencies**
----------------


Planhat's Deployment Strategy group is scaling, and this role exists to help it scale well.


This is a supporting role, and it sits at the center of the team. Your primary job is supporting the Director in building the structure that makes our Deployment Strategists effective: planning frameworks, renewal standards, portfolio reporting, account intelligence, and whatever else the group needs as it grows. Alongside that, you support the Deployment Strategists on key accounts. You will not own the structure and you will not own the accounts. You will make both better, and you will learn more in two years than most people do in five. You will not be handed a portfolio on day one. You will earn one.


Experience matters less than drive, ambition, judgment, how fast you learn, and whether you fit how this team works. Most people who succeed here are recent graduates with a record of performing so
