jobs.title: Customer Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**About Kairon Health**
=======================


Kairon is the execution layer for healthcare. We turn fragmented claims and clinical data into workflows that help ACOs and health networks actually capture their shared savings — not just measure them after the fact. We are a seed\-stage team of under 10, working with live customers managing real patient populations, and we are AI\-native by construction. Our early customers are getting real value; now we are solving the most interesting operational puzzle in a startup — how do we do this 10x without breaking?

**The Opportunity**
===================


You are the daily engine of Customer Operations, reporting to the Director of Customer Operations. Where the Director designs and leads how we onboard, retain, and grow customers, you make it run — turning customer needs into clear, scoped work, keeping account workstreams on track across teams, and closing every loop back to the customer. You live in the seam between customers and engineering, and you’re also the person who spots where a customer could be getting more value from the platform and surfaces it. When a customer says “our numbers look wrong,” you are the one who figures out whether it is a real bug or a misread before an engineer ever touches it.  

  

**Location: Remote (DC \- NYC Corridor)**

**Responsibilities**
====================

* **Daily support triage:** Turn every customer message into clear, owned, and due\-dated work using our internal scoping process; keep the “waiting on us” queue moving toward zero.
* **First\-line troubleshooting:** Reproduce data and metric issues, gather evidence, and resolve directly when possible or hand Engineering a clean, actionable ticket.
* **Customer health \& adoption monitoring:** Track account KPIs, product usage, and trends; identify low engagement, risks, and opportunities and surface them to your Director for proactive follow\-up.
* **Customer value analysis:** Analyze how accounts use the platform and translate findings into clear insights and recommendations for your Director and client stakeholders.
* **Proactive communications support:** Leverage usage analytics, support trends, and recurring customer needs to identify opportunities for proactive customer education, communications, and outreach.
* **Renewal \& growth support:** Maintain a working understanding of account performance and contribute analysis and materials to renewal and expansion conversations led by your Director and Enterprise Growth.
* **Operational coordination:** Keep account workstreams moving day\-to\-day across Engineering, Product, and Sales, ensuring requirements are clearly scoped and nothing stalls between teams.
* **Client meeting support:** Support with preparation of materials, join client calls, capture follow\-ups; your Director will lead or co\-lead the majority of key\-account meetings.
* **Onboarding execution:** Support with onboarding checklists, roster and configuration validation, user setup, and training materials to keep implementations on track.
* **Voice of the customer:** Bring customer feedback, recurring themes, and support trends into internal discussions to inform product improvements and customer strategy.
* **Knowledge base management:** Continuously improve customer\-facing resources based on user analytics, support trends, and customer feedback—identifying opportunities to create new content or optimize existing resources.
* **Weekly operating cadence:** Run the high\-priority requirements report and proactively prepare for bug blitzes and other internal/external meetings; support customer health reporting and ensure product release workflows enable proactive customer communications ahead of launches.

**Qualifications**
==================

* 2\-4 years in operations, implementation, technical support, or consulting where you owned execution and outcomes.
* Strong written communication — a diplomatic customer email and a crisp engineering handoff, and you know the difference.
* Highly organized; energized, not overwhelmed, by juggling many small, important things at once.
* Data fluency: comfortable in spreadsheets and structured data; can spot a duplicate row, a bad identifier, or a metric that jumped for the wrong reason.
* Daily AI\-tool user — because you found it makes you faster, not because you were told to.
* Systems\-thinker: your instinct on a recurring problem is to fix the process, not just the instance.

**Nice\-to\-haves**
===================

* Healthcare, value\-based care, or ACO exposure — or genuine eagerness to learn the vocabulary of shared savings, quality measures, and AWVs.
* SQL, Snowflake, or dashboard and analytics familiarity.
* Experience supporting software implementations or customer onboarding.

**What success looks like in the first 90 days**
================================================

* **Days 1–30:** Own daily support triage end\-to\-end—every inbound is clearly scoped, assigned, and due\-dated within the day—and build fluency in each account’s setup, configuration, and data.
* **Days 31–60:** Keep account workplans and requirements current and moving; independently run the weekly high\-priority report and health scorecards; and begin contributing meaningful analysis and insights to account and renewal conversations.
* **Days 61–90:** Resolve or cleanly scope the majority of first\-line data and metric issues before they reach Engineering; proactively surface customer health, adoption, and value insights; identify opportunities for proactive customer communications; and maintain active follow\-up plans for low\-adoption accounts—freeing the Director to focus on strategy and key customer relationships.

**Why Join?**
=============

* Proven Impact: A platform already driving measurable results — \~$30M in financial value and \~7,000 additional preventive visits across a single customer’s network in 2025 — and winning seven\-figure enterprise contracts.
* Category Credibility: NCQA P

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Patlytics is an AI\-powered patent intelligence platform. IP law firms and in\-house patent teams use us across the patent lifecycle: invention disclosure, drafting, prosecution, portfolio analysis, and infringement and litigation work. Our customers are practitioners who work to a very high standard of accuracy. Our job is to make them faster without costing them any of that precision.

### **The Role**


As a Customer Success Manager, you will own post\-sale relationships with a book of law firm and corporate IP customers. You will be their trusted advisor from onboarding through renewal. You will drive adoption across practice groups, show measurable value to partners and IP leaders, and turn what customers tell you into insight our Product and Engineering teams can act on.


This role suits someone who already knows how legal teams buy, adopt, and resist new technology, and who likes the challenge of earning attorneys' trust.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own a portfolio of customer accounts, including onboarding, adoption, health, renewals, and expansion
* Lead onboarding and training for attorneys, patent agents, paralegals, and innovation or KM teams, tailored to each group's workflows
* Build success plans with clear adoption and ROI milestones, and run regular business reviews with partners, IP counsel, and legal ops leaders
* Watch usage and health signals, spot risk early, and step in before a renewal is at risk
* Find expansion opportunities across practice groups, offices, and use cases, and work with Sales to close them
* Act as the voice of the customer internally. Bring structured, specific feedback to Product and Engineering, and help set roadmap priorities
* Work with Support and Engineering on escalations until they are fully resolved
* Help build the CS function by creating playbooks, onboarding materials, health scoring, and processes that scale

### **What We're Looking For**

* 3\+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation at a B2B SaaS company
* Legaltech experience is required. You have worked with law firms, in\-house legal teams, or both, and you understand how they operate: billable\-hour economics, partner\-driven decisions, KM and innovation teams, and confidentiality and security expectations
* A record of hitting retention, adoption, and expansion goals
* Comfort presenting to senior attorneys and executives, and the credibility to hold your ground with them
* Strong written communication. Your emails, recaps, and success plans are clear, precise, and professional
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage many accounts at once without losing track of details
* Curiosity about AI and how it is changing legal work


Nice to Have

* Experience in IP, patent prosecution, or patent litigation, whether at a firm, in\-house, or at an IP\-focused software company
* A JD, patent agent registration, or technical or scientific background
* Early\-stage startup experience, including helping build a CS function from scratch
* Familiarity with HubSpot or a similar CRM and with customer success tooling

### **How We Work**


Our Cultural Pillars shape how we operate. For this role, a few matter most:

* **Earn Customer Trust Always.** Our customers stake their professional reputations on the work product. You protect that trust in every interaction.
* **Precision Is Part of Speed.** Moving fast only helps if the details are right.
* **Make Progress Visible.** You make customer health, wins, and risks easy for everyone to see.
* **Get Things Done Yesterday, Together.** You act with urgency, and you pull in the right people instead of working alone.


Compensation Range: $100K \- $150K

------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.

* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

* Strong discovery, objection\-handling, and written/verbal communication skills.
* A builder mindset: diagnose results, form a point of view, adapt, and turn what works into repeatable practice.

**Description**

CW Distributing is seeking an experienced and accomplished **Sales Representative** for the Manhattan, Hudson Valley, and Brooklyn New York market, who shares our deep passion for wine, an appreciation for the spirits market, and is dedicated to the competitive sport of selling. If you are excited about joinging one of the fastest growing New York Distributors, this is the gateway to advance your career.

**Responsibilities**

**ACCOUNT \& TERRITORY MANAGEMENT**

* Develop new business and maintain existing customer and relationships
* Achieve sales growth in\-line with stated overall sales goals
* Analyze account base to identify opportunities and discuss product needs through a relationship\-based selling approach
* Ensure maximum brand visibility within accounts by maintaining account KPIs and using effective and current point\-of\-sale materials
* Prepare and deliver professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling displays, merchandising, menu concepts, new products, well and back bar placements, drink and wine lists, and in location promotions
* Maintain customer records, prepare sales materials, and submit orders for processing
* Work with national account team for program compliance

**PRODUCT \& INDUSTRY KNOWLEDGE**

* Stay current and maintain a comprehensive knowledge of wine varietals and international wines in addition to all CW Distributing products, including current prices, vintages, regional identity, awards and press\- establish personal industry networks
* Educate customer and account staff on priority brands by administering educational staff training seminars
* Remain informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending, and actively participating in, weekly sales meetings

**COLLABORATION \& TEAM**

* Contribute to team effort in accomplishing goals
* Collaborate with colleagues to exchange information such as selling strategies or marketing information
* Work with management to achieve company objectives and individual goals

**LEARN \& DEVELOP**

* Engage in continuous self\-education and professional development

**Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in fine wine/spirits wholesale, distribution, and/or importing with established client relationships
* Superior wine and spirits knowledge
* Effective self and time management skills
* Goal oriented, strong work ethic, positive mental attitude, and a team player
* Outstanding relationship building and selling skills
* Excellent organization, follow\-up, and communication skills
* Ability to walk, sit, stand, reach overhead and lift up to 45lbs
* Valid driver’s license required

**Who We Are**Founded in 2014 on the North Fork of Long island, We are a family owned Mid\-size Importer and Distributor here in New York. We speciaize in both Wine and Spirits and look to continue our extremekly strong growth pattern outpacing all market Norms.

**Mission Statement**

Since 2014 our mission has been firmly rooted in our core values of family, integrity, respect, honesty, and hard work. We are deeply committed to upholding these principles for our team members, customers and suppliers alike. We seek to build and maintain long\-lasting relationships based on trust and reliability. By honoring our heritage and embracing innovation, we aim to continuously improve and adapt to meet the evolving needs of our industry, while responsibly contributing to the communities we serve. Together, we strive to elevate the spirit of hospitality and foster a vibrant and respectful culture in all facets of the organization and beyond.

**Pay Range**: The salary is commission based with an estimated annual earnings range of $60,000\-$150,000\.

Job Types: Full\-time, Commission

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: On the road

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. Technology is at the core of change today, and Accenture brings broad capabilities, ecosystem partnerships and a commitment to delivering outcomes that matter.

  

Accenture Edge is Accenture’s purpose\-built business serving high\-growth mid\-market organizations with annual revenues between **$300 million and $3 billion**. Leveraging the power of AI, data, cloud, and Accenture’s deep industry expertise, Edge helps clients accelerate digital transformation, drive operational excellence, and achieve measurable business outcomes through innovative, scalable, and right\-sized solutions tailored to their growth ambitions. You will collaborate with Mid\-Market Account Success Management to support a smooth transition to delivery and client onboarding.


This is a digital\-first sales role. You will identify and progress opportunities through digital and social channels, including LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, AI and generative AI tools. You will also coordinate with marketing teams to develop points of view, support multi\-client campaigns and maintain a disciplined commercial pipeline.

* Join a collaborative, high\-energy team that values creativity, commercial focus and disciplined execution.

  

Travel may be required for role. 0\-80% depending on client and business needs.

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

**Inside Sales \& Account Development Representative**  
**Location:** Wall Street, New York City  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, In\-Office

Ideal Promotions is a growing promotional products and branded merchandise company working with businesses, schools, agencies, and organizations across the country.

We're looking for a motivated, organized, and personable **Inside Sales \& Account Development Representative** to join our team in our Wall Street office.

This is not a traditional cold\-calling position. We're looking for someone who can help take sales opportunities from initial interest through the majority of the sales process, keeping customers engaged, organized, and moving toward a purchase. You'll work closely with our sales team, helping turn opportunities into orders and handing off larger deals when they're ready to close.

**What You'll Do**

* Communicate with prospective and existing customers by phone and email
* Learn what customers are looking for, including their budget, quantity, event date, audience, and goals
* Help source products and put together creative merchandise recommendations
* Prepare quotes, presentations, and customer proposals
* Follow up on open quotes, samples, artwork, and active opportunities
* Keep customers engaged and consistently move opportunities toward the next step
* Reactivate previous customers and identify new opportunities within existing accounts
* Coordinate internally with sales, design, vendors, and operations
* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information in our CRM
* Assist the sales team with day\-to\-day projects and priorities
* Take ownership of smaller opportunities from start to finish as you become comfortable in the role

**What We're Looking For**

* 1–3\+ years of experience in inside sales, account management, sales support, customer success, business development, or another customer\-facing role
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple opportunities at once
* Confident speaking with customers on the phone
* Strong follow\-through and attention to detail
* Comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting to be told the next step
* Able to work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment where everyone helps where needed
* Comfortable learning new software, CRM systems, and sales tools
* A positive, motivated attitude with a genuine interest in sales and business development

Experience in promotional products, marketing, advertising, events, apparel, printing, corporate gifting, or another B2B industry is a plus, but **not required**.

**Growth Opportunity**

We want this person to grow with the company. As you learn our business and prove yourself, you'll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, manage your own accounts, earn performance\-based compensation/commission, and grow into a larger sales or account management role.

**30 hours/week:** about **$30–$35/hour**, or roughly **$47K–$55K annualized**, plus performance bonus.

* New York, NY 10005 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Vascular Services
jobs.description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative \- Vascular Services  
Employment Type: Full\-Time  
Location: New York City, NY  
Travel: Local travel required throughout the territory  
Reports To: VP of Operations  


Position Summary  


We are seeking a motivated and personable Business Development Representative to develop new business relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living communities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare facilities.  


The primary responsibility of this position is to identify facilities that could benefit from our vascular services, establish relationships with administrators and healthcare decision\-makers, educate them about our services, and develop referral partnerships that generate new business.  


This is a relationship\-driven, field\-based sales position for someone who enjoys meeting people, making connections, and developing long\-term business relationships in the healthcare community.  


Key Responsibilities  


Identify and develop relationships with nursing homes, skilled nursing facilities, assisted\-living facilities, rehabilitation centers, and other healthcare organizations.  
Research and identify potential facilities that have a need for vascular services.  
Contact facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, Medical Directors, case managers, discharge planners, and other appropriate decision\-makers.  
Attend Quality meetings at facilities  
Schedule and conduct in\-person visits and presentations with facility leadership and healthcare staff.  
Explain our vascular services and how we can support their residents and patients.  
Develop referral relationships and establish our company as a trusted vascular\-service provider.  
Follow up consistently with prospective and existing facility partners.  
Maintain a pipeline of prospective facilities and track contacts, meetings, referrals, and business opportunities.  
Work closely with our clinical and operations teams to ensure a smooth transition from referral to patient care.  
Attend healthcare networking events, industry meetings, and community events to develop new relationships.  
Identify opportunities to expand services within existing facility relationships.  
Maintain accurate records of business\-development activities and report progress to management.  
Meet established goals for facility outreach, meetings, new relationships, and referrals.  


Ideal Candidate  


The ideal candidate is a self\-motivated, outgoing, and persistent relationship builder who is comfortable approaching healthcare organizations and developing business from the ground up.  


Experience in healthcare sales or business development is preferred, particularly experience working with:  


Nursing homes  
Skilled nursing facilities  
Assisted\-living facilities  
Home health agencies  
Hospice organizations  
Hospitals  
Rehabilitation facilities  
Physician practices  
Long\-term care organizations  


Candidates with strong sales, networking, marketing, or healthcare relationship\-building experience will also be considered.  


Qualifications  


Previous experience in business development, sales, healthcare marketing, or account management preferred.  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  
Comfortable making cold calls and conducting face\-to\-face meetings.  
Professional and confident when speaking with healthcare administrators and clinical leadership.  
Highly organized and able to manage multiple prospects and relationships.  
Self\-directed and able to work independently.  
Reliable transportation and willingness to travel to healthcare facilities.  
Ability to build trust and maintain long\-term professional relationships.  
Familiarity with the long\-term\-care and senior\-care healthcare environment is a plus.  


Performance Expectations  


Success in this position will be measured by activities and results such as:  


Number of qualified facilities identified.  
Facility visits and decision\-maker meetings.  
New facility relationships established.  
New referral partnerships developed.  
Referral volume generated.  
Growth of business within existing facility accounts.  
Consistent follow\-up and maintenance of the sales pipeline.  


Compensation:  


We are open to structuring compensation with a base salary or hourly rate plus performance\-based incentives tied to successful business development and new facility relationships.  


Why Join Us?  


This is an opportunity to play a key role in expanding access to vascular services for residents and patients in long\-term\-care and assisted\-living communities.  


The successful candidate will have the opportunity to build a healthcare referral network, develop meaningful professional relationships, and directly contribute to the growth of the organization.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Operations
jobs.description:
Earthjustice is the nation’s leading environmental law organization. We wield the power of law and the strength of partnership to protect people’s health, preserve magnificent places and wildlife, advance clean energy, and combat climate change. We are here because the Earth needs a good lawyer.


Driven by a passion for justice, inclusion, partnership, and excellence, our core values lead us to seek a broad range of perspectives and backgrounds to achieve our mission and maintain an inclusive environment where all staff are valued and respected.


The Executive Assistant provides executive administrative support to Operations executives by managing schedules, facilitating workflow, supporting projects, meeting and event planning and coordination, and other critical administrative duties. This position anticipates information needs, proactively coordinates information flow, and contributes to the creation of effective systems. The Executive Assistant works independently with minimal direction and is adept progressing action through ambiguity; is exceptionally responsive, action\-oriented, and possesses a keen eye for detail and context; handles confidential matters with sound judgment and utmost discretion; is able to quickly pivot, re\-prioritize, and flex between supporting and complementing different working styles; and is an enthusiastic team player able to identify gaps and problem solve.


Reporting to the Sr. Operations Leadership Team Manager, this position works a full\-time hybrid schedule (37\.5 hours/week) from our San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Denver, CO, or Chicago, IL, office.


This is a non\-supervisory position.

**Responsibilities**

**What You’ll Do**

**Executive Administration and Support (70%)**

* Serve as primary scheduler and calendar manager for Operations executives, coordinating with stakeholders to ensure time is allocated in accordance with strategic priorities.
* Provide administrative and logistical support, including expense filing, travel coordination, document management, and task tracking.

**Meeting \& Logistical Planning, Coordination, and Support (30%)**

* Support department meetings from conception to post\-meeting follow\-through on action items.
* Provide Operations project, initiative, and communications coordination, planning, and execution.
* Facilitate workflow and information sharing with Operations teams and stakeholders; support internal communications within Operations and to the rest of Earthjustice.

**Ongoing Learning**

* Actively pursue professional development and contribute to a culture of learning by building skills and sharing knowledge.


Please note that the percentage breakdowns provided above serve as a guideline and that other duties may be assigned as part of the job’s requirements.

**Qualifications**

**What You’ll Bring**

* 6\+ total years of administrative work experience and/or education.
* Demonstrated experience supporting leadership, managing complex schedules, and supporting on and off\-site meetings.
* Strong Microsoft Outlook calendar management experience coordinating multiple complex schedules across time zones, and exceptional proficiency using the Office365 suite.
* Ability to prioritize and multitask with strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills in a fast\-paced, high\-volume role.
* Outstanding interpersonal, organizational, and verbal/written communication skills.
* Sound judgment and discretion with ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Adaptability, resilience, curiosity, and openness to feedback.
* Demonstrated commitment to Earthjustice’s values of Justice, Excellence, Inclusion, and Partnership.

**Salary \& Benefits**


We offer a competitive salary and excellent, comprehensive benefits. We also offer a casual and congenial work environment.


Salaries at Earthjustice are determined by working location and are commensurate with the experience required.


Salary range in SF/NYC: $102,500 \- $113,900


Salary range in Chicago: $97,500 \- $108,300


Salary range in Denver: $92,300 \- $102,600

**How to Apply**


Interested candidates should submit the following materials via Jobvite. Applications submitted by September 30 will be given priority, and applications received after the priority deadline may be reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

* Resume.
* Cover letter.


Information about our hiring process and tips for success can be found at https://earthjustice.org/about/jobs/hiring\-process. Please reach out to jobs@earthjustice.org if you are having technical difficulties submitting your application.


As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to employment practices that ensure that employees and applicants for employment are provided with equal opportunities without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other factor that is not related to the position.


For positions located within the City and County of San Francisco Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment\-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


For positions located within the City of Los Angeles: We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Laboratory Setting, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)**Job Description**


Join us as a Clinical Research Coordinator II \- And play a key role in overseeing clinical site activities and ensuring high standards of patient care and data integrity.  

  

What You’ll Do:  

* Conduct clinical studies according to FDA/GCP and ICH regulations and guidelines.
* Provide medical care to patients, always ensuring patient safety comes first.
* Schedule subject visits within protocol windows, ensuring scheduling capacity is maximized.
* Perform all defined study activities (i.e., informed consent, screening, and protocol procedures which include but are not limited to vital signs, pregnancy tests, height, weight, ECG's, etc.).
* Record all patient information and results from tests as per protocol on required forms.
* Where required, may complete IP accountability logs and associated information.
* Reports suspected non\-compliance with relevant site staff.
* Ensures that IRB approval is obtained prior to study initiation and IRB requirements are met throughout the study.
* Promotes the company and builds a positive relationship with patients to ensure retention.
* Attend site initiation meetings and all other relevant meetings to receive training on protocol.
* May be required to call patients, do patient bookings and follow\-up calls to confirm bookings or provide information or results.
* Logs/complete information on sponsor systems and ensures all information provided is accurate (i.e., case report forms, EDC, etc.) and ensures it is completed within timeframe.
* Gather and maintain source documents, updates patient files and notes, always ensuring relevant and most up to date information is recorded.
* Adhere to company COP/SCOP.
* May be required to dispose of waste according to standards and assist in keeping a general neat appearance of the facility.

  

Education and Experience:
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
* BLS certificate required.
* Previous experience to provide the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2\+ years’).

  

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.
  

  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  

* Solid understanding of the clinical research process (i.e., GCP, SOPs, informed consent, safety monitoring, etc.)
* Capable of working independently, analyzing and working with attention to detail, processing and prioritizing sensitive complex information and problem solving
* Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and sound judgement
* Good decision\-making, negotiation and influencing skills
* Good communication skills and English fluency will be an advantage
* Good organizational skills
* Good proficiency in basic computer applications
* Good interpersonal skills to work in a team environment

  

Working Conditions and Environment:
  

* Work is performed in an office/ laboratory and/or a clinical environment.
* Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
* Exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Personal protective equipment is required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
* Occasional travel may be domestic or international.

  

Physical Requirements:
  

* Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6\-8 hours per day.
* Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
* Frequent mobility required.
* Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
* Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15\-20 lbs.
* Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in\-house and off\-the\-shelf.
* Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
* Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
* Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi\-task.
* Regular and consistent attendance.

  

Why Join Us?  

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.  

  

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.

jobs.title: Partnerships Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Remote role in the USA**

**Role Overview**

Uncapped lends working capital to e\-commerce sellers across the UK, US and Canada. Some of that business comes through partners: credit brokers, affiliates, agencies, software companies and embedded platforms who introduce sellers to us. Brokers are our largest partner group.


We are looking for someone to own that channel completely. You will decide which partners we go after, bring them in, get them referring, and be accountable for the revenue that comes out of it. It is a broad remit and a visible one. The channel's number is reported weekly and you will be the person who explains it.


You will have a proper stack behind you. PartnerStack is the partner system of record, HubSpot is the CRM, Clay handles enrichment and list building, Instantly and HeyReach run outbound, and Customer.io runs lifecycle comms. All of it is live and already connected, so your time goes on partners and programs rather than on setting tools up.


This is a hands\-on role. You will do the prospecting, build the campaigns and run the reporting yourself. Marketing will build assets you brief and Analytics will build you reporting you ask for, but nobody is dedicated to this channel. If you want to manage a book of relationships and have someone else own the pipeline, the tools and the numbers, this is not the right job. If you want a channel that is genuinely yours to run, it is.

**About Uncapped**

Founded in 2019, **Uncapped** is a leading fintech provider of working \& growth capital to e\-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting\-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e\-commerce platforms — including **Amazon and Walmart** — and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

**What will you do ✍️**

**1\. Recruitment: bring new partners in**


Build and work the pipeline of new brokers, affiliates, agencies and platforms. Source lists in Clay, run sequences through Instantly and HeyReach, take the meetings, agree terms, and get them live in PartnerStack. You are doing your own prospecting.

**2\. Activation: get them to a first funded deal**


Signing a partner is the easy part. Getting them to send a first deal, and then a second, is where most partner programs stall. Own the path from signed agreement to first submission to first funded deal, and set yourself a time limit on it.

**3\. Top partners management: keep them close and keep them informed**


The partners who produce need real attention. Regular contact, honest feedback on what is converting and what is not, quarterly reviews, co\-marketing, early sight of new products. A lot of this is teaching. A broker who understands what we lend against and who we lend to will send better deals, not just more of them.

**4\. The long tail: run it as a program**


Most of the base will never justify a monthly call. Those partners still need to hear from us, so build the always\-on layer that reaches them: segmented Customer.io journeys, newsletters, product and rate updates, reactivation campaigns, and self\-serve material in the partner portal. Decide what good looks like for this group and measure whether the program is working.

**5\. Deal outcomes: own the channel's number**


Our AEs work the deals that partners send. You are still accountable for what happens to them. Chase deals that stall, unblock what is stuck in underwriting, make sure partners hear back, and fix routing when a deal sits with the wrong person. Close the loop with partners on declines and losses so their next submission is better.

**6\. Partner economics and commission**


Commission is a share of the fees we earn, and the rate varies by partner. You will run the payouts, keep attribution accurate, and understand what each partner costs us against what they bring in. Bring us recommendations on which rates should change.

**7\. Reporting and forecasting**


Own the weekly channel report and the forecast: applications, approvals, funded deals and originations, measured against plan. You will be the person who explains the number each week, including in the weeks it is bad.

 **Requirements** **Who you are**

**Must have**

* 3\+ years in partnerships, channel sales, or a similar commercial role. Lending, fintech, payments or e\-commerce SaaS is useful background but not essential
* A track record of building pipeline from scratch and converting it, whether that was partners, direct sales or something else
* Comfort owning a revenue number and reporting against a plan
* Working knowledge of a GTM stack. A CRM plus at least one of a PRM, a sequencing tool or a lifecycle marketing platform. You should be happy setting things up yourself rather than raising a request for it

**Nice to have**

* PartnerStack, HubSpot, Clay, Instantly, HeyReach or Customer.io specifically
* SQL, or a habit of building your own reporting rather than waiting for it
* Having worked on building a channel, rather than inheriting one that already ran

 **Benefits**  

At Uncapped, our people make us successful. We're a start\-up with big goals — we work hard, and we want to give everyone the benefits they really want. Some of what you can expect:

* Competitive base \+ uncapped commission — top performers earn meaningfully
* Unlimited holiday — well\-rested people make the best closers
* MacBook
* Personal growth fund — raise your game from great to spectacular
* Monthly recognition and awards — celebrate wins big and small
* The opportunity to close deals every day with **US e\-commerce founders** building real businesses

**We can only consider applications from candidates eligible to work in the USA without requiring visa sponsorship.**

OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------


As an integral part of the Sales Team, the SDR Manager at OpenGov leads a high\-performing team of Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to drive new business acquisition and customer upsells within the government sector. This role involves managing a team of 8\-10 direct reports, with a strong emphasis on their professional development. The SDR Manager is responsible for not only achieving team targets but also cultivating future Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Solution Engineers, and sales leaders. The role represents a strategic leadership position, focusing on both operational excellence and long\-term talent development within the sales organization.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Lead, mentor, and coach a team of 8\-10 SDRs to achieve their individual and team quotas. Provide guidance and strategic direction to align their prospecting efforts with company objectives and target markets.
* Monitor and analyze team performance metrics, providing detailed reports and actionable insights to stakeholders. Implement strategies for continuous improvement and address any performance issues.
* Hold a personal monthly quota and drive the SDR team to consistently meet or exceed this goal.
* Partner with Marketing and Demand Generation teams to develop and execute effective prospecting strategies, identifying high\-potential leads and upsell opportunities.
* Conduct weekly one\-on\-one and team meetings to offer training, support, and career development for SDRs. Foster a culture of continuous learning to prepare SDRs for future roles, including Account Executives and Customer Success Managers.
* Work closely with the Director, Sales Development to refine processes, training programs, and team culture to optimize results and develop future sales leaders.
* Assist in onboarding and training new team members ensuring they are well\-prepared for their roles. Participate in interviewing, assessing candidates, and making hiring decisions based on performance potential and cultural fit.

------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field .
* 3\-5 years of experience in quota\-achieving sales or business development roles, preferably in the technology or software industry, with a background as an SDR or Team Lead.
* Demonstrated leadership experience with a track record of coaching, mentoring, and developing team members.
* Deep understanding of the sales processes, preferably in SaaS or the government sector.
* Proven track record of meeting sales quotas and contributing to team goals.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in CRM software, preferably Salesforce.com.
* Prior experience with cold calling or sales bootcamp training is advantageous.
* Passionate about the intersection of sales and technology and its societal impact.
* Self\-motivated, creative, results\-driven, solution\-oriented, and competitive.
* Strong team skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate others.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to develop and execute strategic plans, manage performance, and drive continuous improvement.

Atlanta, GA: $110,000 \- $125,000


On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

  

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

jobs.title: Urology Specialty Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Urology Specialty Representative is accountable appropriate product adoption across targeted Urology accounts, including large urology group practices, hospital\-affiliated urology practices, and other high\-potential specialty accounts to drive sales.


This role engages Urologists, APPs, practice administrators, clinical staff, and other key office stakeholders to support patient identification, treatment selection, practice workflow, and appropriate product utilization among eligible patients within the approved indication. The Urology Specialty Representative will meet and/or exceed sales performance objectives in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customer targets within assigned accounts.


The role will require:

* Providing scientific and clinical information within the disease state area and approved product
* Delivering clinically brand sales presentations of approved products to physicians, APPs, medical staff, and other appropriate clinic personnel by utilizing customer engagement selling model
* Effectively utilize and manage all resources to optimize customer engagement
* Collaborate effectively across a highly matrixed sales organization, partnering closely with Organized Provider Account Directors, Reimbursement Managers, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to drive aligned execution and business success.
* Participation in training and development programs while abiding by all industry and corporate policies and procedures


Successful outcome is driving sales in an account setting by convincing HCPs to write prescriptions for indication patients.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Achieve and exceed sales targets within the assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated business plan to maximize sales and prioritize high\-value customers and growth opportunities.
* Translate formulary wins and market access achievements into consistent prescribing and utilization within targeted accounts
* Educate customers on patient eligibility, treatment selection, and the clinical rationale supporting the hospital\-avoidance value proposition.
* Identify and address clinical, operational, behavioral, and process\-related barriers impacting product adoption
* Plan and organize activities to achieve call metrics, optimizing coverage and frequency to key customers to maximize access and sales opportunities.
* Develop in\-depth product and account knowledge, staying informed about local and regional market trends.
* Analyze utilization trends, customer insights, and local market dynamics to identify opportunities and drive performance.
* Conduct educational programs, in\-services, speaker programs, and compliant scientific discussions.
* Collaborate with peers in the sales organization to share best practices and strategies.
* Provide feedback on marketing strategy, analyze the effectiveness of sales activities and territory performance, and develop territory plans with the Regional Sales Director, brand team, and other support partners to deliver exceptional customer experience.
* Manage the territory budget to support sales and marketing activities effectively.
* Complete administrative tasks promptly, executing the company brand strategy and tactics within the assigned geographic area.
* Participate in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate and industry policies and procedures.

**Basic Qualifications**

* BA/BS degree from an accredited institution
* 4\+ years of demonstrated experience and proven sales success in pharmaceutical/medical/biotech industry
* 2\+ years demonstrated large practice group account management experience
* Willingness to travel up to 50%, including overnight travel
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds
* Valid driver's license

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Consistent record of top\-tier sales performance and proven product launch success
* Demonstrated success driving demand generation within large group accounts
* Urology sales experience strongly preferred
* Anti\-Infective experience preferred
* Expertise in account selling and managing complex sales processes.
* Deep knowledge of group practice business model, organizational structure, and key stakeholder roles
* Strong understanding of group practice account decision\-making processes, clinical pathways, formulary management, and antimicrobial stewardship programs.
* Experience collaborating across community and hospital care settings
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
* Analyze data and trends to create actionable business plans
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing market conditions
* Demonstrated ability to adhere to all regulatory, legal, and compliance standards.
* Exceptional presentation and selling skills, coupled with strong business acumen.


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $160,000\-$170,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**


Asset Living is a third\-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single\-family home rentals, affordable housing, build\-to\-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.  



  

Asset Living is a fast\-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.  



  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

 **COMMUNITY MANAGER**


The Community Manager is responsible for overseeing the entire operations of a housing community under the supervision of the Regional Manager. As a Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration \& risk management. As an on\-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

 **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Personnel Management
* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques \& company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop on\-site staff
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Complete weekly/daily office \& maintenance staff schedules and assignments
* Deal effectively and consistently with performance problems; document adequately, communicate with direct supervisor and HR, and terminate appropriately when necessary.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures
* Financial Management
* Achieve the highest possible net operating income through the implementation of effective cost control and revenue \& leasing improvement; identify trends and recommend strategies and adjustments
* Develop yearly operating budgets/forecasts
* Monitor the timely receipt and reconciliation of deposits, rent collections, and charges to ensure they are submitted on a timely basis.
* Monitor the timely receipt, reconciliation, and coding of all vendor invoices
* Ensure property closeout is completed on time and ownership financial reports are accurate
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Develop yearly marketing plan and utilize marketing strategies \& systems
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow\-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents
* Administrative \& Maintenance Management
* Ensure all administrative \& leasing reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted on a timely basis
* Will head emergency team for the property; ensure proper response and handling of all property emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc., within company guidelines to minimize liability.
* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)
* Give direction to and monitor maintenance, construction, and rehabilitation activities to ensure quality and expediency (i.e., “walk” units to ensure make\-ready and work orders are completed)

 **Education/experience**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent; Bachelor’s degree preferred or four year’s experience in the housing industry; or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Certified Apartment Manager (CAM) or Accredited Resident Manager (ARM) preferred.
* Ability to understand and perform all on\-site software functions; basic computer skills required.
* Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.

 **Physical requirements**

jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid\-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.  

ERP analysts in the mid\-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid\-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.  

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid\-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.  

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed\-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.  

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid\-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments. **Responsibilities**


ERP analyst relationships* Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid\-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR\-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid\-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
* Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
* Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid\-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
* Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid\-market platform to their audiences and clients.
* Track analyst\-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.

  

Digital marketing agency relationships* Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid\-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product\-market fit.
* Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co\-marketing and lead\-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
* Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid\-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
* Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co\-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
* Track agency\-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.

  

Portfolio management \& reporting* Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
* Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co\-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.
* Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.
* Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go\-to\-market teams.

  

Cross\-functional collaboration* Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.
* Work with marketing to develop analyst\-specific content programs, agency co\-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid\-market ERP ecosystem.
* Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst\-generated content and recommendations.

* Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long\-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.

jobs.description:
This is a remote role within the United States. US work authorization is required.

 **About VIATechnik:**


VIATechnik is on a mission to lead the built environment in creating a better future, today. We are one team of over 500 digital experts around the globe. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed architects, engineers, tradespersons, researchers, and business leaders. Together, we empower clients through high\-quality, high\-velocity experiences that consistently improve outcomes across the design, construction, and operations of buildings and infrastructure. Our clients include Amazon, Mars Wrigley, and National Geographic, the firms shaping the world's most ambitious projects.

 **Role Overview**


VIATechnik is seeking a Project Coordinator to serve as the central hub keeping our electrical construction projects organized and moving forward. This role handles administrative and project management tasks, supports in tracking project schedules, attend internal and client\-facing meetings, and breaks down work to the appropriate engineering team. You'll support engineering teams by managing documentation and coordinating communication between internal engineers, clients, contractors, and vendors, ensuring projects stay on track, within scope, and within budget. This is a great fit for someone who wants hands\-on exposure to coordinate MEP/electrical engineering projects run from kickoff to closeout.

 **What You'll Do**

* Build a centralized documentation and tracking system across your assigned electrical projects, so meeting notes, RFIs, closeout files, and vendor submittals are logged in a consistent, searchable format within 48 hours of receipt.
* Screen incoming vendor product data and technical submittals against project specifications, catching missing information and formatting issues before they reach engineers and cutting down on submittals returned as incomplete.
* Track schedules and milestones across a portfolio of concurrent projects, and flag any timeline variance to the project manager within 24 hours instead of holding it for the next status meeting.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for routine client and contractor communications, resolving non\-technical questions yourself and routing technical ones to the right engineer without delay.
* Set up coordination meetings, help set up project timelines, join internal and client\-facing calls, capture accurate notes and action items, and follow up until every item is closed.
* Build working proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD within your first six months, opening project models on your own, pulling the views engineers request, and flagging obvious clashes or omissions ahead of coordination meetings.
* Reprioritize daily across competing deadlines as urgent vendor issues and client requests come up.

 **You'd Be a Strong Fit If**

* You have a PMP certification (strongly preferred)
* You have early\-career experience in project coordination, administration, or a related support role, ideally at an architecture, engineering, or MEP firm, and you're the person your team relies on to know where every document and deadline stands.
* You have coordinated projects in construction, engineering, or a related technical field.
* You can keep several projects moving at once and still notice when a date or a missing spec sheet is about to become a problem.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, clients, and contractors, and you know which questions are yours to answer and which belong with an engineer.
* You're curious about BIM and want regular, hands\-on time in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD, even if you're still building that skill set.

 **Why VIATechnik**


This role places you at the center of multiple active electrical construction projects, with regular exposure to new clients, contractors, and technical challenges. You'll work directly in Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD models as part of your everyday work, and as your fluency grows, so does your ownership over vendor documentation, scheduling, and the projects you support. The role is built as a direct path into project management or BIM and VDC coordination.


The pace is fast and decision\-making can be informal. Engineers count on the coordinator to catch problems before they escalate. People who do well here enjoy bringing order to moving parts and stay steady when the plan changes.

  



**Win\-Win Statement**


VIATechnik needs someone who will take ownership of the documentation, scheduling, and communication that keeps electrical projects moving, freeing engineers to focus on design and technical coordination. In return, you get a direct path toward project management or BIM coordination, hands\-on exposure to the tools and projects that make that path real, and a role where your organization and follow\-through are visible in every project's outcome. This is a genuine trade: your reliability for our investment in your growth.

 **Compensation and featured benefits:**

* The pay for this position is **$75,000– $100,000**, and the role is eligible for bonuses. The actual salary offer may be different as we carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, location, and experience
* Health insurance with the choice of five plan options. We cover 70\-95% of premiums for VIATechies and 65% of the premiums for dependents (depending on the plan chosen)
* Dental and vision insurance. We cover up to 75% of the monthly insurance premiums for VIATechies and up to 50% of the premiums for dependents (depending on the plans chosen)
* Open and flexible time off
* A 401(k) plan that is fully vested immediately
* Home office setup costs
* Paid holidays

  

As a minority and woman owned and led company, VIATechnik seeks to build a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. VIATechnik is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for emplo

jobs.description:
**Department**


BSD OBG \- Marketing **About the Department**


The Biological Sciences Division (BSD) is the largest unit of the University. Established in 1930, the BSD is comprised of faculty from the clinical and basic sciences. In this unique academic community, a unified division delivers undergraduate, graduate, medical, and postgraduate education in the biological sciences together with outstanding patient care and world\-renowned research. The BSD currently includes approximately 135 faculty in the 10 basic science departments, over 800 faculty in 13 clinical departments, and 2,400 staff members. The BSD includes the Pritzker School of Medicine (PSOM), approximately 24 academic units, degree\-granting committees, and research centers and institutes. The BSD is located on the University's main campus in Hyde Park, 20 minutes south of downtown Chicago. The Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology has 98 clinical providers: 42 faculty members, ten clinical fellows, 28 residents, ten physician assistants, five midwives, and two advanced practice nurses providing care at the main hospital in Hyde Park and seven off\-site locations. We have more than 45,000 outpatient visits, 20,000 ultrasound encounters, 2,500 deliveries, and perform over 2,500 gynecologic surgeries per year.
  

  

Our physicians see patients at several off\-site locations that are managed by the Department and operate at several hospitals, including Munster Community Hospital in Northwestern Indiana and Northwest Community Hospital in Arlington Heights. The Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology is organized into seven clinical sections: Urogynecology, Gynecologic Oncology, REI, Complex Family Planning, Maternal\-Fetal Medicine, General Obstetrics \& Gynecology, and Minimally Invasive Surgery. Each is led by a section chief who is responsible for carrying out the strategy set for the section. The Department is ranked on the US News and World Report "best" list. Teaching and research are high priorities for the Department.  

  

The residency and fellowship programs are highly ranked and have a history of training leaders in healthcare. The Department also has a significant research enterprise, engaging in population health studies, as well as research conducted in wet laboratories on tumor biology and the mechanisms of hypertensive diseases in pregnancy. Additionally, the Section of Complex Family Planning has established a unique research center, Cl3, which focuses on reproductive policy and innovations in sexual and reproductive health. **Job Summary**


The Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology within the BSD is looking for an innovative, driven Physician Relations and Marketing Specialist to plan, coordinate and execute departmental initiatives surrounding physician relations and marketing development which will support departmental strategy and initiatives. The Physician Relations and Marketing Specialist will lead physician\-referral outreach and patient\-facing marketing for the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, with an initial focus on the Infertility and Urogynecology sections. This role works closely with section chiefs and hospital marketing to grow referral relationships and patient volume through targeted, specialty\-specific communications and campaigns.**Responsibilities**

* Plan and coordinate referring\-physician outreach, including Lunch and Learns, in\-person visits, and ongoing relationship\-building with community and regional providers.
* Under direction, develop and print digital collateral — flyers, brochures, and referral materials — tailored to each specialty.
* Participate in managing the department's social media presence, including content planning, posting, and engagement.
* Collaborate with existing marketing leadership to execute digital patient\-direct marketing campaigns to drive appointment volume.
* Communicate effectively with hospital, departmental, and section leadership on priorities and project updates.
* Track and report on referral activity, digital engagement, and new\-patient volume tied to marketing efforts
* Partner with the hospital marketing team to ensure alignment with institutional brand and messaging standards.
* Provide support to Senior Communications and Events Coordinator in driving departmental outreach and growth across all media platforms.
* Problem solve delays and other obstacles in an effort to ensure outreach projects are achieving set deadlines.
* Collaborate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
* Uses moderate/solid understanding and experience to administer the delivery of services to program participants and/or beneficiaries.
* Has moderate/high levels of interactions with faculty, researchers and staff for committee work or information.
* Performs other related work as needed.

Minimum requirements include a college or university degree in related field. **Work Experience:**


Minimum requirements include knowledge and skills developed through 2\-5 years of work experience in a related job discipline. **Certifications:**

**\-**

**Preferred Qualifications**

 **Experience:**

  

* 1\-3 years of experience in marketing, communications, or physician liaison/relations work; healthcare experience preferred.
* Strong writing and content\-development skills across print, digital, and social channels
* Comfort working directly with physicians and clinical leadership.
